title: Product Design Júnior
description:
Vaga para Product Designer Júnior | 100% Remoto

Na Mouts , acreditamos que tecnologia e design têm o poder de transformar experiências — de forma descomplicada, eficiente e com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Designer Júnior para atuar de forma remota , colaborando com times multidisciplinares no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais que fazem a diferença.


Suas responsabilidades:

  • Criar e evoluir experiências digitais em parceria com produto e tecnologia;
  • Liderar iniciativas de discovery e mapeamento de jornada do usuário;
  • Produzir fluxos, protótipos e interfaces com foco em usabilidade e acessibilidade;
  • Conduzir sessões de ideação e testes de usabilidade;
  • Traduzir insights em soluções funcionais, intuitivas e visualmente consistentes.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em design de produtos digitais (com portfólio);
  • Boa comunicação e clareza na apresentação de ideias;
  • Atuação em todo o ciclo do produto, do discovery à entrega;
  • Forte domínio de UX/UI e foco no usuário;
  • Inglês avançado (vai interagir com times e stakeholders globais).


O que você encontra na Mouts:

  • Programa de indicação premiada (profissionais e clientes);

Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

Visualização de Dados: Proficiência em Looker Studio (Data Studio) para construção de relatórios e painéis automatizados e performáticos.

- O foco é na integração de web analytics (GA4) com big data (GCP/BigQuery), impulsionando decisões em marketing, produto e operações com dados massivos de comportamento de usuários e transações automotivas (ex.: insights de compra/venda de veículos).

- O papel é de alto impacto, exigindo liderança técnica em governança de dados e comunicação executive.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
About Us:

Stingrai is a rapidly growing cybersecurity startup specializing in offensive security solutions and continuous security assessments. We are redefining the frontier of cybersecurity by building the next generation of tools, including our proprietary PTaaS (Penetration Testing as a Service) platform, an AI-powered pentesting agent, and a comprehensive Dark Web monitoring tool.


Our mission is to help organizations proactively identify and mitigate threats through autonomous, intelligent security. We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to lead the ongoing development of our platforms and help architect the future of AI in offensive security.


Role Overview:

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will lead the full lifecycle of development tasks from concept and architecture to implementation and deployment. This is a high-impact, fully remote role where you will work closely with the founder and our Research & Development (R&D) team. You will have the independence to manage projects and the technical expertise to ship robust, secure, and scalable features in a fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect & Build AI Agents: Design and implement core logic, memory, and tool orchestration for our autonomous AI pentesting agents.
  • Lead Platform Development: Drive the enhancement of the Stingrai PTaaS platform, Ai-powered pentesting agent and Dark Web monitoring tools using the MEAN/MERN stack. Independently build, deploy, and maintain scalable and secure web-based applications.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Independently build, deploy, and maintain scalable applications on AWS.
  • Collaborative R&D : Work with security researchers to translate complex offensive security workflows into automated, AI-driven features.
  • Security & Performance : Integrate front-end and back-end components with third-party APIs securely, while continuously improving application performance and usability.
  • Code Quality: Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to maintain high engineering standards.


Qualifications:

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.
  • 5+ years of proven experience as a full-stack developer with a strong proficiency in Node.js, React/Next.js, MongoDB/Express, and GraphQL.
  • Demonstrable experience building and architecting AI agents (using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or similar agentic architectures).
  • Demonstrable experience with database systems, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Proficient understanding of secure coding best practices and cybersecurity considerations.
  • Ability to independently manage projects, tasks, and deadlines.
  • A quick learner who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently manage projects, tasks, and deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in cybersecurity, specifically offensive security or penetration testing.


Why Join Us?

  • We offer competitive rates based on the applicant's location and seniority, aligned with current market benchmarks.
  • 2 weeks of paid holiday per year.
  • Work remotely with a flexible schedule, contributing significantly to meaningful cybersecurity solutions.
  • Join a fast-paced, innovative team passionate about cybersecurity and technology.
  • Opportunity to lead impactful projects independently and grow professionally in a dynamic environment.


How to Apply:

Please submit your resume and a cover letter that addresses the questions below. Applications that do not include responses to these questions in the cover letter will not be considered.


  • Briefly describe an AI agent or LLM-powered system you have architected. What frameworks did you use?
  • Which stack are you more proficient in: MERN or MEAN? Do you have experience with Next.js and UI/UX development?
  • Tell us about a time you had to independently lead a project or learn a new technology on a tight deadline.
  • Location: What is your current location/timezone for compensation benchmarking?

title: SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst – (E-invoice)
description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Business Systems Analyst to expand our E-invoice integrations offering.


Job responsibilities/ Role Requirements include:

• Provide subject matter expertise on tax determination, reporting and compliance (including e-invoicing)

• Perform detailed analysis, feasibility, and integration design of business processes within SAP S/4HANA modules (MM, SD, and FI) to the integration

• Assist in project management, implementation planning and test approach / planning

• Solid understanding of tax data flow between organizational systems, technical architecture, integrations, and data pipelines between ERP and Tax/ compliance systems.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross functionally with other Functional Consultants, Developers/ Architects, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, Tax Research, Customers and Prospects

• Prepare detailed Functional Specification documentation with use cases, PowerPoint presentations, and other documents to explain requirements internally and externally.

• Support the product development process, working closely with Development, QA and Documentation teams throughout the whole product life cycle, feature validating functionality, as well as preparing the rest of the organization for product release.

• Assist with end-user documentation, process flows, specifications, and diagrams to provide direction to customers, partners and professional services, and support teams.

• Support product rollouts and implementations as domain expert and/or primary business interface to other parties.

• Follow product into the field to ensure customer success, providing business and data integration expertise to customers, partners and internal professional services personnel as needed.

• Assist in providing 2nd level support and training to Customer Support, Professional Services, and integration partners.

• Provide business expertise in sales calls as needed.


Qualifications

• Working experience in SAP localization requirements

• Working experience in Indirect Tax Compliance and E- Invoicing

• Experience in SAP S/4HANA configuration and implementation (FI, SD or MM) and Strong knowledge in various SAP business processes in FI, SD and MM and cross module integrations.


We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: ANALISTA CLOUD / DEVOPS
description:
Estamos contratando: ANALISTA CLOUD / DEVOPS (Período Noturno)


A MAPS S.A. está expandindo seu time e busca um(a) Analista Cloud / DevOps para atuar em horário noturno , contribuindo diretamente para a operação de uma plataforma SaaS robusta, segura e altamente escalável para o setor financeiro.

Se você gosta de desafios, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e deseja trabalhar com tecnologias modernas na AWS, esta vaga pode ser para você!


Sobre a MAPS S.A.

Somos uma empresa especializada em soluções SaaS para instituições financeiras, com aplicações web de alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança, sustentadas em uma infraestrutura moderna na AWS.

Nosso time é responsável por toda a operação, envolvendo:

  • Desenvolvimento e gestão de aplicações web para o mercado financeiro, com foco em confiabilidade e compliance ;
  • Arquitetura e operação de infraestrutura 100% em nuvem , atendendo requisitos regulatórios;
  • Provisionamento e gerenciamento de VPCs, sub-redes, balanceadores, clusters e serviços de rede, garantindo segurança , isolamento e alto desempenho ;
  • Administração de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB , com foco em performance e resiliência;
  • Uso de sistemas de mensageria e eventos como SNS/SQS e Kafka ;
  • Orquestração de contêineres com Amazon ECS ou Kubernetes ;
  • Construção de pipelines CI/CD para automatizar testes e deploys;
  • Monitoramento, observabilidade e automações com métricas e alertas inteligentes;
  • Cultura DevOps voltada à colaboração, eficiência e melhoria contínua.


Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Facilidade em aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Tipo de contratação e benefícios

  • Contratação CLT;
  • 100% Home Office;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Banco de Horas;
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Birthday Off;
  • Acesso à plataforma Alura.

A MAPS S.A. está expandindo seu time e busca um(a) Analista Cloud / DevOps para atuar em horário noturno , contribuindo diretamente para a operação de uma plataforma SaaS robusta, segura e altamente escalável para o setor financeiro.

Se você gosta de desafios, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e deseja trabalhar com tecnologias modernas na AWS, esta vaga pode ser para você!


Sobre a MAPS S.A.

Somos uma empresa especializada em soluções SaaS para instituições financeiras, com aplicações web de alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança, sustentadas em uma infraestrutura moderna na AWS.

Nosso time é responsável por toda a operação, envolvendo:

  • Desenvolvimento e gestão de aplicações web para o mercado financeiro, com foco em confiabilidade e compliance ;
  • Arquitetura e operação de infraestrutura 100% em nuvem , atendendo requisitos regulatórios;
  • Provisionamento e gerenciamento de VPCs, sub-redes, balanceadores, clusters e serviços de rede, garantindo segurança , isolamento e alto desempenho ;
  • Administração de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB , com foco em performance e resiliência;
  • Uso de sistemas de mensageria e eventos como SNS/SQS e Kafka ;
  • Orquestração de contêineres com Amazon ECS ou Kubernetes ;
  • Construção de pipelines CI/CD para automatizar testes e deploys;
  • Monitoramento, observabilidade e automações com métricas e alertas inteligentes;
  • Cultura DevOps voltada à colaboração, eficiência e melhoria contínua.


Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Facilidade em aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Tipo de contratação e benefícios

  • Contratação CLT;
  • 100% Home Office;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Banco de Horas;
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Birthday Off;
  • Acesso à plataforma Alura.

title: ⭐ Closer
description:
Sobre a vaga



Prazer, somos o time Comunitive!


Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos: oferecemos soluções inovadoras para engajamento de colaboradores e comunicação interna com foco em gamificação. Já atendemos mais de 300 clientes, incluindo grandes nomes como, Bosch, L’Oreal, Algar, Óticas Diniz, Sicoob, Caju, Gupy, entre outras. E estamos apenas começando!


Em 2025 fomos eleitos Top #1 HRTech do Brasil pelo 100 Open Startups e melhor software de engajamento de colaboradores pelo B2B Stack.


Nosso propósito é transformar o ambiente corporativo, ajudando empresas a engajar seus colaboradores e fortalecer uma cultura onde cada pessoa se sinta conectada, feliz e valorizada. E queremos que você venha fazer parte dessa missão com a gente!


Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e inquietos que queiram:

  • Conduzir vendas complexas de soluções customizadas para Recursos Humanos e Comunicação Interna usando tecnologias modernas e gamificação;
  • Realizar reuniões de demonstração e apresentação da solução Comunitive para áreas de Recursos Humanos, Comunicação Interna e Endomarketing;
  • Gerenciar uma rotina comercial dinâmica e de alta velocidade, com frequência de agendamentos de reuniões, negociações e follow-ups constantes com os clientes;
  • Identificar o estágio de maturidade da Comunicação Interna de cada empresa, ajudando-as a implementar processos de automação, gamificação e análise de dados.


Características do nosso time que também queremos ver em você:

  • Intensidade e vontade de crescer em um time unido e em constante evolução;
  • Mão na massa, atitude positiva, curiosidade, resiliência e otimismo;
  • Habilidade para buscar soluções criativas e não óbvias em projetos com múltiplos decisores.


Outras qualidades que consideramos importantes:

  • Nível superior completo (sem restrições de cursos);
  • Boa comunicação e habilidades interpessoais;
  • Experiência com vendas B2B e conhecimento dos processos de compras em grandes empresas;
  • Experiência em HRTechs ou Martechs;
  • Habilidades de negociação e conhecimento de metodologias de vendas;
  • Foco em resultados e paixão por desafios;
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia em vendas para ou em departamentos de Recursos Humanos e/ou Comunicação Interna.
  • Rede de contatos/Networking voltado a profissionais de Recursos Humanos e/ou Comunicação Interna.


Na Comunitive você vai:

  • Trabalhar com pessoas apaixonadas que utilizam as melhores práticas para resolver problemas de forma criativa e eficiente;
  • Participar da construção de um produto de alto impacto que afeta milhares de pessoas e aproxima a relação entre marcas e colaboradores;
  • Ajudar a construir uma empresa de nível global que vai brigar com os grandes players do setor;
  • Aprender muito e enfrentar desafios que vão impulsionar seu crescimento profissional;
  • Ser feliz! Dá uma olhada no nosso Glassdoor


Benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Vale Alimentação no Caju;
  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Clube de Descontos (Creditas);
  • Day-off de aniversário;
  • Programa de Engajamento e Recompensas.

title: Portuguese Speaking  Reporter  UK / Brazil
description:
Portuguese Speaking Reporter | €35K | Remote

We’re a global media and events leader at the centre of the iGaming B2B ecosystem — covering the technology, regulation, data, platforms, and commercial engines that power online gaming worldwide. This isn’t consumer‑facing content; it’s the heartbeat of the industry.

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Desenvolvedor PHP sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Desenvolvedor PHP Sênior

Conhecimento profundo das versões mais recentes do PHP.

Experiência com programação orientada a objetos (OOP) e padrões de design.

Experiência com CodeIgnite, Laravel é um diferencial.

Experiência com Drupal

Experiência com MySQL.

Habilidade em otimização de consultas e modelagem de dados.

Experiência com Git e plataformas como GitHub, GitLab.

Experiência com Docker.

Experiência com CI/CD (Integração Contínua/Entrega Contínua) é um diferencial.

Experiência com TDD (Test-Driven Development) e BDD (Behavior-Driven Development).

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship


We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.


What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.


We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.


Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.


What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc.


Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Developer with experience in developing and maintaining trading applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Redis, and Kafka. Candidates who have experience with Order Management Systems (OMS), exchange connectivity, FIX protocol, execution algorithms will be preferred.

You will work closely with portfolio managers, traders, quants, and other technologists to build robust, scalable, and low-latency systems that support our investment and trading activities.


  • Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain core components of our Order Management and Execution Management Systems (OMS/EMS).

• Build and enhance exchange and broker connectivity including support for FIX protocol messaging and APIs.

• Work on trade lifecycle management, including order creation, routing, execution, and post-trade processes.

• Collaborate with traders and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

• Optimize system performance for low latency, high throughput, and fault tolerance.

• Provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 8+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally in financial services.
  • Strong experience in Java, Spring boot, Kafka, Redis, SQL or similar technologies.
  • Strong understanding of multi-threading, concurrency, and performance tuning in Java.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot real-time trading issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Available and ready to provide level 3 support for production trading systems when necessary.


Languages:

English: C2 Proficient

title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL
description:
Title: Data Architect with Snowflake, Python and Advance hands-on SQL

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Travel Coordinator
description:
Our Company :A fast-growing start-up headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA in the heart of Silicon Valley. We recruit worldwide as our customer base is global. Reliable ground transportation provider, any type of vehicle globally.


Vision: Reliable ground transportation services globally with all types of vehicles.


Mission: Empower high-quality local fleets


Corporate Culture:

  • Team first partner-centric
  • Team collaboration,
  • Never \"not my job\", end-to-end ownership,
  • Continuous learning and improvement,
  • Hard-working and pragmatic,
  • Don’t be a middleman,
  • Result-driven


Responsibilities:

  • Constant negotiation with new drivers and fleet companies and maintaining existing supplier for Ground Transport services in geo-assigned
  • Negotiation of rates for ground transportation services
  • Ensure availability and competitive prices for ground transportation services.
  • Participate in market and competition researchCoordinate and resolve issues from supplier side notification, cancelations, and operational problems among others
  • Analyze market trends for pricingProblem-solvingMake calls to the appropriate driver to assign a ride. Performing Last Minute assignment.
  • Confirm the ride was done and apply the change in the system or ask the driver to do it.
  • Contact Drivers for rates negotiation and onboardingAssisting with internal communications with CS, QA, and other departments
  • Customer Service support.


Experience:

3 years experience working in the Tourism & services sector, tourism product management.

3 years experience working in travel agencies, hotels or any tourism (required)

Knowledge of the for-hire vehicle industry.

Operational skillsStrategy implementation experience (required)Impeccable problem-solving skills.

Excellent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

Ability to prioritize and manage their time effectively.

Fast-paced work environment

Attention to details



Benefits:

100% Remote job, no need to commute to or from office.

Earn variable compensation

Work in a startup company with great growth potential in leadership and responsibility.

Collaborate with a multicultural team members distributed over in 17th countries.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Staff Engineer você será uma referência técnica transversal, com forte influência sobre decisões arquiteturais, padrões de engenharia e evolução da plataforma que sustenta todos os times de produto.

Você não estará focado em uma squad específica, mas sim em elevar o sistema como um todo: confiabilidade, escalabilidade, segurança, developer experience e eficiência operacional.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Influenciar e guiar decisões arquiteturais de médio e longo prazo da plataforma
  • Definir e evoluir padrões técnicos para serviços, infraestrutura, observabilidade e CI/CD
  • Atuar como guardião da qualidade técnica, reduzindo complexidade e dívida técnica
  • Trabalhar próximo a Tech Leads, SREs e Tech Managers, ajudando a desambiguar decisões difíceis
  • Projetar e evoluir plataformas e serviços compartilhados (infra, pipelines, templates, SDKs, ferramentas internas)
  • Garantir alta confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança dos sistemas em produção
  • Atuar fortemente em observabilidade, troubleshooting e resposta a incidentes críticos
  • Promover uma excelente Developer Experience, melhorando fluxos de build, deploy, testes e operação
  • Mentorar engenheiros(as) de diferentes níveis, elevando o padrão técnico da organização
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas elegantes, incrementais e sustentáveis
  • Tomar decisões orientadas por métricas, dados e impacto real no negócio


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida como engenheiro(a) sênior / staff / principal
  • Forte domínio em Node.js e Typescript.
  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos
  • Sólido conhecimento em Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (GCP/AWS/Azure)
  • Excelente domínio de observabilidade, troubleshooting e sistemas em produção
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e mentoria
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas complexas equilibrando negócio, engenharia e operação


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você:


  • Já atuou fortemente em times de plataforma ou SRE
  • Já trabalhou em projetos de grande porte utilizando Python
  • Tem experiência com arquiteturas event-driven
  • Conhece e aplica DDD, Clean Architecture e Ports & Adapters

title: IBM TM1 / Planning Analytics Consultants - WORKING INTO THE US & CANADA
description:
IBM PLANNING ANALYTICS SENIOR TM1 CONSULTANTS


FANTASTIC NEW JOB BASED IN BRAZIL TO WORK INTO CLIENTS IN THE US & CANADA TORONTO!!


CONTRACT OR PERMANENT -


In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing financial planning solutions using IBM Planning Analytics to achieve project success as agreed with customers; deliver technical, functional, and business outcomes of a project and maintaining high standards of professional communication.


Accountabilities include, but are not limited to:


  • Analysis and evaluation of business requirements through a structured methodical approach
  • Define the solution scope, time, cost and risk by translating business requirements into a set of functional and non-functional deliverables.
  • Estimate and plan project deliverables and success criteria
  • Identify project Risks and Assumptions
  • Communicate with stakeholders, business and technical project teams to ensure the roles and responsibilities for the solution deliver are understood
  • Implementation of financial planning solutions in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 as designed in the solution scope definition
  • Identify all potential Change Requests and work with designated Principal Consultant/ Project Manager on these variations
  • Participate in Post Implementation Review and assume ownership of any actions


Desired Skills and Experience


Essential


  • Greater than 5 years’ experience in delivering financial planning applications (IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 will be highly valued);
  • Minimum education level of Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a relevant subject – Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, Finance & Accounting;
  • Proven project experience delivering financial planning solutions covering most phases of the project lifecycle including scoping, requirements gathering, design, development, testing and deployment while using project management methodologies;
  • In-depth knowledge and senior level expertise in IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 including cube design, turbo integrator processes & rule engine; IBM Cognos TM1 Certified Developer would be an added advantage;
  • A genuine talent for grasping complex business problems and engineering effective solutions;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Highly Regarded


  • Background in finance and understanding of financial processes such as budgeting & forecasting or supply chain roles is desirable;
  • Well developed skills/ability researching, designing and implementing customer solutions and programs;
  • Strong relationship management;
  • Ability to identify opportunities and taking action to help achieve business goals;
  • Ability to identify process improvement opportunities;
  • Team player with a professional, pro-active approach
  • Citizenship is highly regarded but not essential.

title: Consultor BPA
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) BPA Sênior para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, atuando em projetos de migração de automações para um de nossos grandes clientes.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em BPA (Business Process Automation) no SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em migração de RPAs, especialmente de SAP IRPA para BPA (BTP), utilizando ferramentas nativas da SAP.
  • Atuação no apoio funcional e técnico durante as fases de planejamento, migração, testes, ajustes e estabilização das automações.
  • Capacidade de analisar, adaptar e validar processos automatizados, garantindo aderência aos novos padrões do BPA.
  • Vivência no suporte à execução de testes unitários, integrados e de aceite (UAT) das automações migradas.
  • Experiência em projetos SAP, com interface entre áreas de negócio e times técnicos, garantindo alinhamento de requisitos e entregas.


Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 09h às 18h

title: FullStack Developer Sênior - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!


Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamos Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para fazer parte dessa jornada.


Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Objetivo do Papel


Desenvolver e evoluir interfaces, serviços e integrações que viabilizam o uso dos agentes de IA, garantindo uma experiência fluida, estável e integrada aos sistemas existentes.


Atuar de forma hands-on no frontend e backend, conectando aplicações, dados e agentes.



Responsabilidades Principais


Desenvolver aplicações frontend e backend integradas aos agentes de IA.


Implementar APIs, serviços e camadas de integração entre sistemas.


Garantir conexão eficiente com bancos de dados e serviços corporativos.



Atuação Técnica (Hands-on)


Desenvolver frontend utilizando React e SAPUI5 .


Desenvolver backend utilizando Node.js, Typescript e Python.


Implementar comunicação entre frontend, backend e agentes de IA via APIs e serviços.


Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, garantindo modelagem, performance e integridade.



Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais


Conhecimento macro das linguagens e frameworks de frontend e backend adotados.


Experiência com consumo e exposição de APIs (REST).


Noções de arquitetura de aplicações, integração de sistemas e segurança.


Integrar aplicações com agentes de IA e serviços inteligentes.



Requisitos e qualificações

Frontend :

  • React
  • SAPUI5

Backend :

  • Node.js
  • TypeScript
  • Python

APIs e Integrações :

  • APIs REST para comunicação entre frontend, backend e agentes de IA
  • Integração com serviços corporativos e agentes inteligentes

Bancos de Dados :

  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais (modelagem, performance e integridade)

Arquitetura e Segurança :

  • Noções de arquitetura de aplicações , integração de sistemas e segurança de APIs


Informações adicionais


Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!


Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.


É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.


Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Verity Learning
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê



E aí, topa criar experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital?

title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.g., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: DESENVOLVEDOR SRE / DEVOPS – PLENO
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos buscando um SRE/DevOps Pleno para atuar em um Squad de Plataforma, com foco na evolução da Internal Developer Platform (IDP) e melhoria contínua da experiência dos times de desenvolvimento. 

A missão é remover gargalos operacionais, automatizar processos críticos e garantir resiliência, observabilidade e escalabilidade da infraestrutura baseada em AWS. O sucesso da função será medido pela facilidade e eficiência com que as squads utilizam a infraestrutura entregue.


Responsabilidades

• Evoluir e manter a Internal Developer Platform (IDP). 

• Projetar e manter pipelines de CI/CD baseados em GitOps. 

• Construir, padronizar e orquestrar containers e workloads no Kubernetes. 

• Realizar troubleshooting avançado de containers, pods e objetos K8s. 

• Criar e manter infraestrutura AWS utilizando Terraform (IaC). 

• Garantir escalabilidade, resiliência e performance dos ambientes produtivos. 

• Implementar observabilidade: logs, métricas e alertas. 

• Automatizar operações utilizando scripts e ferramentas internas. 

• Participar de definições arquiteturais e boas práticas da plataforma. 

• Apoiar e colaborar com squads consumidoras da IDP. 


HARD SKILLS (COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS OBRIGATÓRIAS)


Internal Developer Platform (IDP)

• Experiência comprovada em construção/evolução de IDPs. 

• Definição de padrões, abstrações e automações para outras squads. 


Kubernetes

• Criação e manutenção de containers.

• Operação de objetos K8s: Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps,  

• Troubleshooting de workloads em ambientes produtivos. 

• Segurança de containers e gestão de recursos. 

• Foco na engenharia de containers, não apenas operação do cluster. 


AWS + Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)

• Forte domínio de Terraform em ambientes AWS. 

• Serviços essenciais: EKS, EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch. 


CI/CD (GitOps)

• Experiência com pipelines automatizados.

• Ferramentas GitOps: ArgoCD, FluxCD ou similar. 


Linguagens de Automação

• Fluência em pelo menos uma linguagem: Python, Go ou Shell Script.


SOFT SKILLS (COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS)

• Comunicação clara e efetiva com equipes técnicas. 

• Autonomia e ownership.

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias e riscos.

• Colaboração com múltiplas squads.

• Organização e disciplina.

• Resiliência diante de cenários complexos.


DESEJÁVEIS

• Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. 

• Segurança avançada em cloud (IAM, CIS). 

• Experiência prévia com grandes clusters Kubernetes. 

• Vivência em squads de plataforma/SRE. 

• Testes de carga, stress e performance.


Benefícios

* Plano de Saúde Bradesco (colaborador + dependentes)

* Plano Odontológico

* Seguro de Vida

* Vale Refeição / Vale Alimentação – R$ 1.400,00

* Vale Transporte (quando aplicável)

* Auxílio Home Office – R$ 70,00

* Gympass

* Apoio a Educação & Certificações

* Programa Global de Bem Estar


Modalidade de Contratação: CLT

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.


The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.


Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.


Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).


Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a \"deliver fast\" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.


Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

Location

Fully remote position.

Requisition Number:

Experience Level: Mid to Senior

Job Family: Engineering/Science/Technology

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

Employee Group: Temporary

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.



What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time or later, Monday to Friday

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado , permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions


A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos buscando perfis para o nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em consultoria técnica. Este profissional será o responsável por dar vida às soluções, atuando tanto na configuração de novos projetos (implementação) quanto no atendimento especializado para garantir a continuidade e evolução das ferramentas nos nossos clientes.


⚠️ Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional . Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização ) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.


O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: \"If/Then\" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL , Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.


Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.


Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.


Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado , permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

title: Japanese Business Developer
description:
Mayflower is a technology company that alters the entertainment industry to a new level of perception and engagement.

We are developing a partner advertising high-load system with a large RPS, convenient and modern interface. We are growing exponentially and successfully implementing new technologies to accelerate this growth and the system as a whole.

Now we look for a Japanese Business Developer to join our Growth Traffic team


Job Responsibilities

Research and Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough market research on Asian markets to identify opportunities for business expansion.
  • Perform competitive research to stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and potential market gaps.

Lead Generation:

  • Identify and qualify potential affiliates and business partners within target markets across Asia.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective affiliates, tracking outreach progress and follow-ups.

Outreach and Communication:

  • Proactively initiate contact and establish relationships with potential affiliates and business partners.
  • Manage initial outreach, clearly communicating our company’s value proposition to prospective partners.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  • Regularly report on progress, including research insights, outreach results, and onboarding statuses.
  • Collaborate closely with senior account managers and cross-functional teams to align affiliate strategies and achieve team goals.


Requirements

  • Fluency in Japanese language is a must
  • Fluency in English
  • At least one year of experience in lead generation or business development.
  • Strong Network: Ability to leverage an existing network of contacts to expedite outreach and sales
  • Communication Skills: Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Self-Starter: Capable of working autonomously in a remote environment, with the motivation to consistently drive results.


Qualification that can be a plus:

  • Proven track of overachieving KPIs in Business Development or Sales positions.


Conditions

We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here's what you can expect when joining us:

  • Full remote work.
  • Competitive compensation with a service contract.
  • Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments.
  • An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most.
  • Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.
  • Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions.
  • A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team.

title: Analytics Engineer Pleno (CLT) | Remoto
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira Analítica de Dados Pleno para compor o time de Engenharia Analítica do Gran e mudar vidas com a gente!


O Gran é um ecossistema que une educação e tecnologia , que acelera e customiza o aprendizado para diferentes necessidades e momentos e que já impactou mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Hoje temos 2 verticais principais: a de Cursos Preparatórios e a Gran Faculdade.


Atualmente, são mais de 820 mil alunos e alunas , presentes em mais de 1.500 municípios brasileiros . Temos como motivação possibilitar uma educação de alta qualidade que seja diversa e inclusiva, geográfica e economicamente. Nossa tecnologia de ponta é um catalisador que impulsiona para muitas possibilidades de futuro.


Somos grandes defensores da ideia de que a educação é um direito de todos e fazemos o máximo para tornar isso uma realidade Brasil afora. Sabemos que a educação é a chave para muitos futuros possíveis e temos as ferramentas que facilitam o acesso de milhares de brasileiros ao ensino, em vários níveis.


Essa vaga está no nosso modelo de trabalho Gran Mundo , sendo 100% remoto. Dessa forma, você não precisa comparecer ao escritório, apenas em casos eventuais que serão avisados com antecedência e custeados pelo próprio Gran.


Todas as nossas vagas são no modelo de trabalho CLT.

title: Junior .NET Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We seek a proficient Junior .NET Developer capable of maintaining high standards of technical quality and innovation, dedicated to continuous improvement, and committed to assisting clients worldwide. Success in this role requires detailed knowledge of development techniques, excellent communication, and organizational skills.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect and develop various services and APIs

- Apply SOLID principles to craft maintainable and high-quality code

- Collaborate with product owners to ensure features/changes align with business requirements and degreed strategy

- Engage closely with designers, UX, and other developers to grasp new features, dependencies, and technical intricacies

- Fulfill other assigned duties


Requirements:


- Advanced proficiency in English (spoken and written)

- Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL Databases

- Experience with Microservices and the Cloud

- Knowledge of algorithms

- Understanding of IT infrastructure

- Proficiency in managing Agile methodologies

- Familiarity with best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions

- Understanding of Design Patterns

- Experience in developing entire applications from scratch

- Proficiency in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with version control

- Strong skills in unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Design Executive
description:
Vantage is a global, multi-asset broker based in Sydney, offering clients access to trading CFDs on Forex, Commodities, Indices, Shares, and Cryptocurrencies. With over 10 years of market experience, Vantage has a strong presence with more than 1,000 employees across 30 global offices. Vantage provides a trusted trading ecosystem and a user-friendly platform for clients to capitalize on trading opportunities.


Client Relationship Growth Design Executive


Key responsibilities:


  • Assist in the creation and execution of visual assets for digital and print platforms, including websites, social media, emails, and promotional materials.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, product, and sales) to produce design solutions that align with brand guidelines and business objectives.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to project specifications.
  • Maintain and organise design files, ensuring easy access and consistency across projects.
  • Adapt and optimise designs based on feedback from stakeholders, ensuring alignment with brand voice and vision.
  • Stay updated on design trends, tools, and techniques to contribute fresh ideas and innovative solutions to the team.
  • Assist with photo editing, typography, and layout adjustments as needed.
  • Create and edit video content and GIFs for social media, marketing campaigns, and web use.


Qualifications


To be successful in this role, you’ll have:


  • Qualification in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong understanding of design principles, typography, colour theory, and layout composition.
  • Experience in creating and editing video content and GIFs using video editing tools.
  • Experience with 3D design and modelling software.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to present ideas clearly.
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to manage time effectively, and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and respond well to constructive feedback.
  • A portfolio showcasing a range of design work across different mediums (please include with your application).
  • Great interest in the finance and trading industry.
  • Additional digital marketing skills are advantageous.



Perks

  • Young and talented team, and you will get full support from everyone.
  • We do great work, and you will be a part of the amazing journey.

title: Senior Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | U.S. Market


Blue Dot BPO connects strategic LATAM talent with mission-critical operations at U.S.-based companies. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an Executive Recruiter to lead high-impact executive hiring processes while working directly with senior leadership teams in the United States.


This is a fully remote role with a high level of autonomy, international exposure, and end-to-end ownership of executive recruiting processes.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000 , plus additional bonuses in USD
  • Fully remote work (Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM BRT )
  • Long-term contract with real growth opportunities
  • Strategic exposure to U.S.-based executives and C-level teams
  • Multicultural, performance-driven environment focused on process, accountability, and meritocracy


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead full-cycle executive recruitment for senior and leadership roles
  • Develop advanced sourcing strategies and market mapping
  • Conduct structured interviews and in-depth candidate assessments
  • Manage strategic pipelines and stakeholder relationships
  • Coordinate interview processes with U.S.-based teams
  • Ensure operational excellence in ATS usage and recruitment data


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in executive recruiting / headhunting
  • Fluent English (C1/C2) for daily professional communication
  • Hunter mindset , analytical thinking, and strong results orientation
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and job boards
  • Strong communication skills, a consultative approach , and high organizational standards


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in full-cycle executive recruiting
  • Familiarity with U.S. recruiting practices and market


Technical Requirements

  • Laptop with i7 processor (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • Two monitors for daily operations
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office environment


Build Your International Career

If you want to work directly with the U.S. market, gain executive-level recruiting experience, and grow in a high-performance, process-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.
