title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.
  • Communication & Influence – Clearly articulates financial insights and recommendations; influences decision-making through well-reasoned analysis.
  • Results Orientation – Drives deliverables to completion with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and value creation.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility – Quickly assimilates new information, adjusts to changing deal dynamics, and continuously seeks to enhance technical and market knowledge.
  • Leadership & Mentoring – Provides guidance to junior members, reviews work outputs, and helps raise the overall quality of the team’s deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project finance, M&A, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling tools (Excel, VBA).
  • Experience in cross-border transactions within LATAM markets.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining technical results to financial stakeholders.

Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

title: Desenvolvedor JAVA Sênior
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Código da oportunidade: 56985

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Java, Springboot, mensageria, conceitos de devops, esteira CI/CD, terraform e AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Mid Backend Developer - .NET
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Compor time de desenvolvimento;
  • Realizar levantamento de requisitos, documentar, projetar e implementar soluções;
  • Garantir o atendimento aos requisitos estabelecidos;
  • Gerir de forma autônoma as próprias tarefas;
  • Demonstrar habilidades de resolução de problemas de forma proativa.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Domínio de .NET Framework, .NET Core e ASP.NET Core REST APIs;
  • Experiência com frameworks de acesso a dados, como Entity Framework, LINQ, ADO.NET ou Dapper;
  • Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo recursos de integração;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados relacionais e não relacionais e em SQL Server;
  • Aplicação de princípios DDD, SOLID e padrões de projeto;
  • Aplicações em camadas MVC, MVP, MVVM e em ambientes multi-tenancy;
  • Uso de containers e orquestração, como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em mensageria e integrações, como Service Bus, Event Hub e REST APIs;
  • Utilização de Git para controle de versão;
  • Ensino superior completo em TI.

title: System Engineer - Infrastructure and Storage
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

- Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.

• Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server

• Upgrading ESXi

• Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring

• Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs

- Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions

- Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable

- Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis

- Basic Linux administration

- On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

- Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)

- Server Hardware Management

- Virtualization, especially VMware

- Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP

- Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments

- Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Managing backups

- Dell Server Hardware

- PowerShell

- Python

- Storage Platforms such as EMC, Netapp, Isilon, etc.

- Storage Protocols, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS

- Storage Virtualization

- Storage Security, including access controls and encryption data at rest

- Ansible


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização . Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Luxury Travel Agent
description:
Job Title: Luxury Travel Advisor/Consultant/Agent


About Our Client

Our client is a high-end leisure travel company specializing in luxury, complex international travel experiences . They serve discerning clients who expect white-glove service, deep destination expertise, and seamless execution from planning through post-travel follow-up.


The company operates in a fast-paced, client-facing environment where communication, accuracy, and relationship management are critical. Their advisors act as trusted partners, not just booking agents, delivering personalized, detail-oriented travel experiences across the globe.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Luxury Travel Advisor to join the team and manage high-end leisure travel planning for a global client base. This is a full-time role (40 hours/week) , with PST hours preferred .


The ideal candidate has strong experience designing complex international itineraries, is confident working directly with clients via phone and Zoom, and brings a deep understanding of global destinations, airlines, cruise lines, hotels, and leisure travel products.

This role is highly client-facing and requires exceptional communication skills, attention to detail, and comfort handling changes, revisions, and real-time travel issues.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and book luxury leisure and complex international itineraries
  • Use Sabre GDS for air bookings, ticketing, exchanges, and fare optimization
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients from planning through post-travel follow-up
  • Provide destination expertise and personalized travel recommendations
  • Collaborate with the Support team on: Ticketing, Hotels, Tours, Cruises, Special requests
  • Manage itinerary changes, revisions, and client issues before or during travel
  • Maintain accurate client and trip records in Salesforce
  • Upsell additional services when appropriate to enhance the client experience
  • Deliver professional, clear communication via phone and Zoom at all times


Must-Have Requirements

  • Proven experience as a Luxury Travel Advisor or similar client-facing travel role
  • Strong hands-on experience with Sabre GDS
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Confidence working directly with clients via phone and video calls (Zoom)
  • Deep understanding of: World geography, Airlines, Cruise lines, Hotels
  • Luxury leisure travel products
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple itineraries and client needs simultaneously


Nice-to-Have Requirements

  • Experience working with high-net-worth or luxury clients
  • Prior experience using Salesforce
  • Background in complex international or multi-leg itineraries
  • Upselling or revenue-driven travel advisory experience
  • Experience working remotely with U.S.-based clients


Bonus & Compensation Structure

  • Bonus eligibility begins after a 90-day ramp period
  • Bonus potential increases over time based on: Performance, Revenue generated, Upsells, Client retention


Role Details

  • Position: Luxury Travel Advisor/Agent
  • Commitment: Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Schedule: PST hours 9 am-5 pm PST
  • Contract Type: Long-term

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

title: Founder Associate (Growth)
description:
Location: Brazil (remote-first, with collaboration across Europe & Latin America)

Languages: English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (plus)


About OpenHealth

OpenHealth is building the infrastructure layer for health data , harmonizing and enriching laboratory results to power clinics, labs, insurers, and health-tech companies across Europe and Latin America. Our mission is to unlock the full value of medical data to enable better clinical decisions, preventive care, and AI-driven health innovation.

In 2025 OpenHealth raised it’s second institutional investment round, invested by selected leading Venture Capital firms from Europe:


What You Will Do

As Founder Associate , you will work directly with our CEO and act as a force multiplier across strategy, growth, project execution, operations, and fundraising . You will take full ownership of strategic initiatives , from definition to execution, and ensure that the most important projects move fast and deliver impact.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects end-to-end with full ownership, such as new market entries, launch of new products, or strategic partnerships
  • Own project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and delivery
  • Drive cross-functional programs across product, tech, growth, operations, and external partners
  • Support enterprise clients and strategic partners , including preparation of proposals, business cases, and pilots
  • Prepare board- and investor-ready presentations, decision memos, KPIs, and performance reports
  • Conduct market, competitor, customer, and investor research to support strategic decisions and positioning
  • Improve and scale internal processes and workflows , leveraging automation and AI where possible
  • Support fundraising and investor relations , including pitch materials, data rooms, investor outreach, and follow-ups
  • Act as a sparring partner to the CEO , helping prioritize initiatives, challenge assumptions, and execute across multiple workstreams simultaneously


Who You Are

You are a high-ownership, execution-focused strategic generalist who enjoys operating close to decision-making and turning strategy into results.

Your profile likely includes:

  • A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Medicine , or a similarly analytical field
  • 1–3 years of high-impact professional experience , e.g. in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, Big Tech, health-tech, or an early-stage venture-backed startup
  • Demonstrated experience in project management , owning complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders from planning to execution
  • A clear track record of leading strategic projects under full ownership , such as new market entries, international expansion, or go-to-market initiatives
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking , with the ability to turn complex problems into clear, actionable plans
  • Proven ability to work directly with C-level executives , driving initiatives with measurable impact
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability – you proactively identify problems and deliver solutions
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with shifting priorities
  • Known for being reliable, persistent, and outcome-driven , with a strong bias toward execution


What Matters to Us

  • Strong motivation for the health industry , ideally with first exposure to healthcare, health-tech, life sciences, or medical data
  • Interest in how technology, data, and AI can meaningfully improve healthcare systems and patient outcomes
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business, technical, and medical stakeholders
  • A mindset of ownership, learning, and long-term impact


Languages & Location

  • English: Fluent
  • Portuguese: Fluent
  • Spanish: Plus / nice to have
  • Location: Brazil - São Paulo or Florianopolis (working closely with teams and partners in Europe & Latin America)


Why Join OpenHealth?

  • Work directly with the founders on company-defining initiatives
  • Take full ownership of strategic projects with visible impact
  • Exposure to international markets, enterprise clients, and investors
  • Steep learning curve across health-tech, data, AI, and B2B SaaS
  • Clear growth path into senior strategy, operations, or leadership roles

title: Business Performance Analyst
description:
We are hiring!


Please find the job description below. If you're interested, I would appreciate it if you could share your updated resume with me.


Role: Principal Business Performance Analyst

Location: LATAM - Remote

Type: Contract

Job Description:

We are seeking a Principal Business Performance Analyst to drive personalization and affiliate marketing analytics within our Marketing Technology team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights that improve user experience, conversions, and recurring revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze the impact of personalization initiatives on key user and business metrics
  • Deliver actionable insights from affiliate performance data to drive conversion and revenue growth
  • Lead A/B and multivariate testing to optimize affiliate offers, landing pages, and user journeys
  • Develop customer segmentation and attribution models to evaluate campaign effectiveness
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau, Data Studio, or similar tools
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Tech teams to improve funnel performance and affiliate strategy


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced analytics using Python or R
  • Experience with A/B testing, personalization, and experimentation
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate marketing analytics
  • Expertise with data platforms such as BigQuery, AWS Athena, or AWS Glue
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

We are seeking a Principal Business Performance Analyst to drive personalization and affiliate marketing analytics within our Marketing Technology team. This role focuses on turning complex data into actionable insights that improve user experience, conversions, and recurring revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze the impact of personalization initiatives on key user and business metrics
  • Deliver actionable insights from affiliate performance data to drive conversion and revenue growth
  • Lead A/B and multivariate testing to optimize affiliate offers, landing pages, and user journeys
  • Develop customer segmentation and attribution models to evaluate campaign effectiveness
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau, Data Studio, or similar tools
  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Tech teams to improve funnel performance and affiliate strategy


Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced analytics using Python or R
  • Experience with A/B testing, personalization, and experimentation
  • Hands-on experience with affiliate marketing analytics
  • Expertise with data platforms such as BigQuery, AWS Athena, or AWS Glue
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e manter fluxos de trabalho operacionais para pagamentos transfronteiriços (cross-border ), incluindo transações em moeda fiduciária (fiat ) e stablecoins , bem como atividades de VASP.
  • Monitorar custos de transação, identificar ineficiências e propor melhorias para aprimorar o desempenho operacional.
  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, rastreamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins .
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Assegurar a conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e controles de risco internos, incluindo verificações de KYB/KYC/AML, relatórios e preparação para auditorias.
  • Coordenar com parceiros bancários, mesas de OTC e equipes internas para garantir liquidação, reconciliação e gestão de liquidez tranquilas.
  • Desenvolver e implementar SOPs (Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão) escaláveis e ferramentas operacionais para apoiar o crescimento do negócio, garantindo confiabilidade e consistência entre os mercados.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins , fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

Qualificações Preferenciais:

  • Proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

Tipo de vaga: Tempo Integral

  • Termos Técnicos: Mantive termos como Stablecoin , VASP , OTC , SOPs e KYC/KYB/AML em inglês ou com a sigla original, pois são padrão na indústria de cripto no Brasil.
  • Adaptação Cultural: O tom é profissional, mas direto, típico de vagas de tecnologia no Brasil.

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios


Principais Responsabilidades

- Traduzir necessidades de negócio em indicadores, análises e visualizações claras

- Construir, manter e evoluir dashboards executivos e operacionais

- Realizar análises exploratórias e diagnósticas, identificando padrões, tendências e oportunidades

- Apoiar decisões estratégicas por meio de insights orientados por dados

- Atuar na modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física)

- Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade

- Trabalhar com dados estruturados e semiestruturados

- Garantir consistência entre fontes, métricas e camadas analíticas

- Documentar métricas, indicadores e fontes (data dictionary / métricas oficiais)

- Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados e boas práticas analíticas

- Atuar na resolução de inconsistências e problemas de dados

- Apresentar análises de forma clara, didática e orientada à ação


Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

- Experiência sólida como Analista de BI / Dados

- Domínio de SQL (consultas complexas, CTEs, otimização)

- Experiência com modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, etc.)

- Vivência com ferramentas de BI

- Experiência com Python ou R para análise de dados (pandas, numpy, etc.)

- Conhecimento em ETL / ELT e pipelines de dados

- Experiência com bases de dados relacionais e analíticas

- Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud (AWS)


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Infrastructure and Storage System Engineer
description:
Project description

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities

- Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.

Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server

Upgrading ESXi

Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring

Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs - Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions - Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable - Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis - Basic Linux administration

On-call support


Skills

Must have

Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)

Server Hardware Management

Virtualization, especially VMware

Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP

Security, including best practices, patch management, and vulnerability assessments

Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages

English: C1 Advanced

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

title: Sourcer Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação LATAM e Brasil da AI/R Company , grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias avançadas de sourcing ;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos , apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter ;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca ;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos .


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Desejável vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas ;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Desejável Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: Especialista em Eficiência Energética I
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: Analista de Dados Pleno | Engenharia e Modelagem de Dados
description:
A Fasters está procurando gente talentosa para formar um time que irá atuar na área de desenvolvimento. Irá fazer parte de um ambiente voltado para inovação e irá participar ativamente no crescimento do projeto.


Buscamos um profissional com boa comunicação, que tenha facilidade de se relacionar com pessoas e que esteja constantemente se atualizando em busca de novos conhecimentos da área.


Essa vaga se destina para todo o Brasil :)


Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de ETL em larga escala, otimizados para eficiência e confiabilidade.

• Implementar processos de qualidade e validação de dados.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de BI e Data Science para suportar projetos analíticos.

• Garantir o desempenho, a escalabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas de dados.


Soft Skills:

• Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico para resolver problemas complexos.

• Comunicação efetiva e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

• Proatividade e atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.

• Adaptabilidade e resiliência.

• Gestão de tempo e priorização.


Hard Skills:

• Experiência com modernização de BI (conhecimento sobre migração de ETL e Data Warehousing).

• Modelagem de dados para analytics (criação de Data Lakes, Data Warehouses e Data Marts).

• Experiência com banco de dados relacionais e dimensionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Vertica).

• Apache Airflow.

• Conhecimento em streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).

• Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL e otimização de consultas.

• Domínio do Python e suas bibliotecas.

• Conhecimento em Spark e PySpark.

• Governança de Dados (aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, como LGPD, GDPR, Privacy by Design).


Diferenciais

• Experiência com machine learning e modelos preditivos para análise de dados.

• Conhecimentos em Delta Lake.

• Experiência com API para dados em tempo real.

• Conhecimentos de cloud (AWS, Azure)


Regime de contratação PJ, 40h semanais.


Informações adicionais:

  • Acesso a plataformas de cursos.
  • Descanso remunerado;

 SharePro — Tecnologia para Inovação

A SharePro  desenvolve soluções de software robustas e escaláveis para ambientes corporativos críticos. Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que já superaram o nível júnior, entregam com regularidade e querem evoluir tecnicamente rumo ao nível sênior.


Responsabilidades

  • Compreender requisitos técnicos e funcionais definidos pelo negócio ou pelo time técnico
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações utilizando tecnologias .NET, seguindo padrões e boas práticas
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs REST
  • Atuar em correções, melhorias e manutenção de sistemas existentes
  • Executar testes e apoiar a identificação e correção de falhas
  • Apoiar processos de implantação e integração em ambiente produtivo
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros desenvolvedores e áreas envolvidas
  • Buscar apoio técnico quando necessário e escalar riscos de forma responsável


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno  ou equivalente
  • Conhecimento sólido em .NET / .NET Core
  • Experiência com APIs REST
  • Conhecimento intermediário em SQL Server  (modelagem e consultas)
  • Experiência com MVC
  • Versionamento de código com Git
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis
  • Capacidade de seguir arquiteturas e padrões definidos


Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência ou contato com Azure
  • Noções de CI/CD
  • Contato com DevOps  e automação
  • Experiência inicial com Docker / containers
  • Conhecimento em Blazor


Perfil comportamental

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de explicar soluções técnicas
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de média complexidade de forma independente
  • Organização, responsabilidade e comprometimento com prazos
  • Boa gestão do próprio tempo e das atividades sob sua responsabilidade
  • Postura colaborativa, abertura a feedbacks e aprendizado contínuo
  • Perfil com boa performance operacional , entregando demandas com consistência, qualidade e produtividade adequada ao nível pleno
  • Interesse genuíno em evolução técnica e crescimento profissional

Buscamos um Analista Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno  para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução das nossas aplicações, com boa autonomia técnica, seguindo arquiteturas e diretrizes definidas, e com foco em entregas consistentes e de qualidade.

Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que já superaram o nível júnior, entregam com regularidade e querem evoluir tecnicamente rumo ao nível sênior.


Responsabilidades

  • Compreender requisitos técnicos e funcionais definidos pelo negócio ou pelo time técnico
  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações utilizando tecnologias .NET, seguindo padrões e boas práticas
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs REST
  • Atuar em correções, melhorias e manutenção de sistemas existentes
  • Executar testes e apoiar a identificação e correção de falhas
  • Apoiar processos de implantação e integração em ambiente produtivo
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com outros desenvolvedores e áreas envolvidas
  • Buscar apoio técnico quando necessário e escalar riscos de forma responsável


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno  ou equivalente
  • Conhecimento sólido em .NET / .NET Core

title: Analista / Especialista em GIS & Documentação Técnica
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida base em Sistemas de Informação Geográfica (GIS), com perfil comunicativo e organizado, capaz de atuar na documentação técnica, apoio a usuários e disseminação de boas práticas em soluções GIS, especialmente em redes de utilities.



Principais competências e conhecimentos esperados:


  • Conhecimento em GIS, com entendimento de dados espaciais, mapas, camadas, simbologia e fluxos de trabalho.
  • Experiência ou familiaridade com redes de utilities (água, esgoto, energia, telecom ou gás), incluindo conceitos de ativos, conectividade e operação.
  • Boa escrita técnica, com capacidade de elaborar documentação clara, objetiva e orientada ao usuário.
  • Experiência com Git (controle de versões), incluindo versionamento de documentação, organização de repositórios e colaboração em equipe.
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica e funcional, como manuais, guias rápidos, FAQs, wikis e notas de versão.


Produção de materiais instrucionais, incluindo:


  • Tutoriais passo a passo
  • Vídeos explicativos
  • Figuras, diagramas e fluxos de uso para apoio ao usuário
  • Boa comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal, com capacidade de dialogar com perfis técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com padronização e qualidade da informação.


Diferenciais desejáveis:


  • Experiência com plataformas GIS corporativas ou WebGIS.
  • Vivência em ambientes colaborativos e multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de documentação técnica e UX writing.
  • Experiência prévia com projetos de utilities ou infraestrutura.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We are seeking highly skilled Chemistry and Mathematics professionals to develop high-quality Chain of Thought (CoT) Question & Answers for advanced scientific and mathematical problem-solving.

The ideal candidate will have strong conceptual foundations, rigorous analytical skills, and experience in structured scientific reasoning. Proficiency in LaTeX is essential for producing clear, well-formatted, step-by-step solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed Chain of Thought (CoT) Q&As across advanced scientific and mathematical domains.
  • Ensure logical coherence and structured reasoning in both questions and solutions.
  • Use LaTeX for precise scientific notation and documentation.
  • Collaborate with internal review teams to ensure consistency and quality.
  • Conduct in-depth reviews to maintain scientific accuracy and adherence to guidelines.
  • Contribute subject-matter expertise across the following domains:


Chemistry

  • Polymer Chemistry
  • Analytical Chemistry
  • Physical Chemistry
  • Inorganic Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry



Qualifications & Skills (Consolidated)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in relevant Chemistry domains.
  • Strong academic or research expertise with the ability to create structured scientific explanations and step-by-step analytical solutions .
  • Mandatory experience in academic content development, research, or structured Q&A creation .
  • Strong proficiency in LaTeX for technical and scientific writing.
  • Excellent analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving ability , and attention to detail.
  • Ability to simplify complex concepts into clear, logically structured reasoning .
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, review-driven environment .
