title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Unix Linux System Administrator
description:
Your role and responsibilities:


  • Lead L2/L3 production and project support for Linux environments
  • Manage installations, patching, migrations, and scripting (Shell & Perl)
  • Troubleshoot hardware/software issues across Linux, HP-UX, Solaris, and AIX
  • Optimize system performance and availability
  • Coach and mentor team members
  • Work with ITIL-based tools and monitoring systems


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Hands-on experience in Linux and Unix systems
  • Deep expertise in filesystem, volume, and storage management
  • Strong knowledge of networking, clustering (PCS), and system hardening
  • Familiarity with SAN/NAS, backup tools (TSM, VEEAM), and storage suites (EMC, NetApp, Hitachi)
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
  • Flexibility to work weekends and non-standard hours
  • Advanced English


Bonus Points:


  • Linux certification
  • German language skills
  • Experience with Veritas Cluster, Apache, DNS, DHCP, LDAP

title: Customer Success (CS) – Tur.com
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional dedicado(a) e orientado(a) para Customer Success (CS), que desempenhará um papel fundamental na implementação e no sucesso contínuo dos Operadores Turísticos no Marketplace de Tours, Atividades e Atrações da tur.com no Brasil. -->


O(a) CS será responsável por orientar novos Vendors no uso eficaz da nossa plataforma, garantindo sua satisfação, crescimento e fidelização. Atuará como ponte entre os times de Produto, Vendas e Suporte, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da experiência de pós-venda.


Responsabilidades

Implementação e Treinamento

● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Oferecer treinamentos detalhados sobre o uso da plataforma, assegurando que os Operadores Turísticos compreendam todas as funcionalidades disponíveis.

Suporte Contínuo

● Atuar como principal ponto de contato para os Vendors, prestando suporte contínuo e solucionando dúvidas ou problemas.

● Monitorar o desempenho dos Vendors na plataforma e fornecer recomendações para melhorar sua presença e aumentar as vendas.

● Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Atendimento ao Cliente para resolver problemas oriundos dos clientes finais e coordenar ajustes necessários com os Operadores Turísticos.

Sucesso do Vendor

● Desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para melhorar o desempenho de cada Vendor, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização.

● Coletar feedback e colaborar com o time de Produto para aprimorar funcionalidades-chave.


Requisitos

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.

● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.

● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.

● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.


Oferecemos

● Salário competitivo.

● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por garantir o sucesso dos clientes, trabalhar em equipe e contribuir para o crescimento do nosso Marketplace, te convidamos a se juntar a nós!

title: Fechador
description:
Estamos contratando: Closer de Vendas | GMT Comércio de Ferramentas

A GMT Comércio de Ferramentas atua no fornecimento de materiais metálicos e ferramentas para indústria, construção e manutenção. Trabalhamos com clientes de médio e grande porte, com ticket médio acima de R$ 50.000.

Buscamos um(a) Closer experiente para conduzir negociações de alto valor com tomadores de decisão em indústrias, construtoras e distribuidores.

Sua rotina:

  • Conduzir negociações comerciais por telefone e videochamada com clientes B2B de ticket elevado (R$ 50k+)
  • Aplicar o método SPIN Selling para identificar dores, implicações e construir propostas de valor sob medida
  • Realizar alto volume de ligações estratégicas — aqui o telefone é a principal arma
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas comerciais de materiais metálicos e ferramentas
  • Fazer follow-ups consistentes e gerenciar pipeline no CRM
  • Desenvolver relacionamento de longo prazo com carteira de clientes ativos e novos

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida com vendas B2B por telefone (mínimo 1 ano)
  • Domínio do método SPIN Selling ou metodologias de venda consultiva similares
  • Perfil agressivo comercialmente — gostar de ligar, negociar e fechar
  • Habilidade para lidar com ciclos de venda mais longos e valores altos
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas negociações simultaneamente
  • Boa comunicação verbal — clareza, objetividade e poder de persuasão

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com venda de materiais metálicos, ferramentas, insumos industriais ou materiais de construção
  • Conhecimento técnico de produtos metalúrgicos (aços, tubos, chapas, conexões, etc.)
  • Vivência com vendas para indústria, construtoras ou distribuidores
  • Histórico comprovado de fechamento em tickets acima de R$ 30k

Remuneração e benefícios:

  • Salário fixo: R$ 3.000 + ajuda de custo
  • Comissão agressiva sobre fechamentos (OTE)
  • Média esperada de ganhos: R$ 8.000/mês (ajuda de custo + comissão)
  • Sem teto de comissão — quanto mais vende, mais ganha
  • Treinamento sobre nosso portfólio de produtos e processos comerciais

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

Important Information

As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

  • Hands-on object oriented programming experience in Java;
  • Hands-on object oriented experience in Javascript/NodeJS;

  • Experience developing Restful APIs;
  • Experience working in agile teams;
  • Experience with code versioning with Git;

  • Development of secure web applications;

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency
  • Prior people management or team-lead experience
  • Experience working alongside people / ER or HRBP roles
  • Exposure to B2B, outsourcing, or billable team models


Key responsibilities

HR operations & lifecycle management

HR systems & tools ownership

  • Own and administer HRIS systems (HiBob or comparable platforms) as the system of record
  • Configure workflows, task lists, permissions, and reporting in HR systems
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and up-to-date team member data
  • Partner with internal teams to integrate HR tools with Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace, and other productivity systems

Compliance & operational risk

  • Ensure compliance with local labor regulations, internal policies, and HR controls across geographies
  • Own HR-related audit readiness and evidence gathering (including SOC2-related controls where applicable)
  • Maintain HR documentation, SOPs, and policy acknowledgements
  • Adapt policies and practices to meet regional needs while maintaining consistency

Manager enablement (process-focused)

  • Provide managers with clear guidance on HR processes, timelines, and required documentation
  • Act as the primary owner of HR operational questions and requests
  • Escalate judgment-based or sensitive employee relations matters to the director of global HR

HR team support & execution

  • Support, mentor and coordinate the work of HR Specialist or other team members as it relates to HR operational tasks
  • Prioritize operational work, ensure follow-through, and reduce single points of failure
  • Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency using existing tools and AI-enabled workflows


What this role is not

  • This role does not own employee relations judgment, PIPs, or conflict mediation
  • This role does not serve as a people partner or HR business partner
  • Strategic people decisions and leadership coaching sit with the Director of Global HR

title: Senior Software Engineer – Platform
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability Operations

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Type: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and improve system design to reduce failure modes and promote self-healing systems
  • Establish and maintain robust systems that facilitate observability, encompassing logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, and offline test tools.
  • Work with development partners to shape the architecture, design, and implementations of new and existing systems to enhance their reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability
  • Ability to work both independently as well as part of a geographically dispersed yet integrated team.
  • Collaborate with service engineers to establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for backend services.
  • Being able to identify the indications or cues that demonstrate the effectiveness of an application and having the knowledge to improve or repair its performance
  • Ability to assess options and suggest solutions when there is limited or unclear information. This position requires a level of comfort and assurance in dealing with uncertain situations.
  • Ability to work seamlessly within a team as well as manage individual tasks
  • Respond to emerging incidents, solve critical issues, and follow through with a plan for resolution or future mitigation
  • Act as an SME on the Engineering Operations team, partnering with backend services teams and application teams to overcome challenges across all the platforms where we stream our service

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience in software development
  • Degree in Computer Science or related or equivalent work experience
  • You have solid engineering and coding skills, data structure knowledge, and the ability to write high-performance production-quality code.
  • Experience building service-oriented APIs and cloud services
  • Experience designing, implementing, and deploying microservices
  • Extremely technical hands-on server software experience
  • Proficient in Golang, and JavaScript, and quick to learn new languages.
  • Experience in the Linux environment and a good understanding of its fundamentals and internals: filesystems and modern memory management, threads, and processes, the user/kernel-space divide, etc.
  • A good understanding of large-scale distributed systems in practice, including multi-tier architectures, application security, monitoring, and storage systems.
  • Working knowledge of the TCP/IP stack, internet routing, and load balancing.
  • Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership.

Bonus Points for Experience with the following:

  • Golang
  • Typescript
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Open telemetry
  • eBPF

title: Pessoa Analista de DP Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa


A Oficina é parceira estratégica na criação de reputação e relacionamento, por meio de histórias e causas que transformam o país.


Em 2025 lançamos um novo modelo de negócios que integra a agilidade de uma agência, a profundidade estratégica de uma consultoria e a força de uma atuação em rede.

Nesse contexto, nasceu a Rede de Reputação e Influência , a primeira Community as a Service (CaaS) de Reputação e Influência do Brasil. A iniciativa reúne 40 empresas parceiras com atuação regional e nacional, combinando tecnologia, inteligência e colaboração para antecipar cenários e apoiar decisões com agilidade e precisão.


Nos pautamos em valores como respeito, diversidade, inquietude, ética, excelência no atendimento e trabalho em equipe. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, inovador e orientado a resultados, com modelo híbrido, plano de carreira estruturado e investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Responsabilidade e atribuições


  • Executar e consolidar a folha de pagamento;
  • Conferir encargos e recolhimentos;
  • Executar admissões e rescisões complexas;
  • Controlar obrigações recorrentes;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais;
  • Orientar tecnicamente a equipe;
  • Atender auditorias operacionais;
  • Manter controles e documentações atualizadas.


Requisitos e qualificações


Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência com: Lançamentos de dados, verificação e fechamento da folha de pagamento, encerramento dos encargos mensais (FGTS, INSS, IRRF), processamento dos relatórios gerenciais da folha, contabilização, provisionamento, 13º salário, suporte em gestão de benefícios, controle de ponto, rescisão e férias, aplicação da CLT e CCT, envio de leiautes e fechamento do SPED e-Social, DCTF Web, RPA, tratamento de afastamentos pelo INSS, envio das obrigações anuais - DIRF e outras rotinas pertinentes à área de administração de pessoal.


Aqui, o compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão é transversal à estratégia da empresa: todas as vagas são destinadas também a mulheres, pessoas pretas, indígenas, LGBTQIAP+, pessoas com deficiência e profissionais 40+.


Fazer parte da Oficina é integrar um time que constrói, de forma ética, inovadora e colaborativa, a Nova Era da Reputação e Influência no Brasil.

title: Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


Buscamos um (a) Analista de Dados que seja a principal referência técnica da empresa no uso estratégico e tático do ecossistema Google para dados. O papel exige proficiência total no Google Analytics 4 (GA4) para extrair insights profundos do comportamento do usuário e uma base sólida no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularmente o BigQuery, para manipular e analisar grandes volumes de dados. Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões baseada em dados em toda a organização.

Principais atividades:

- Liderar em Google Analytics (GA4):

- Gerenciar e otimizar totalmente a implementação e configuração do GA4, garantindo a mais alta qualidade e integridade dos dados de comportamento do usuário.

- Definir e manter o plano de mensuração completo (eventos, parâmetros, dimensões personalizadas) via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Governança de Dados via GCP/BigQuery:

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Escrever e otimizar consultas SQL avançadas, realizando operações de ETL/ELT para combinar dados de GA4 (via exportação direta), CRM e outras fontes.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

Visualização e Comunicação:

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Os candidatos devem demonstrar proficiência e experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

- Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiaridade sólida com a plataforma GCP, incluindo Cloud Storage e IAM.

- BigQuery e SQL: Avançada para escrever, otimizar e gerenciar consultas SQL complexas em ambientes de Big Data (BigQuery).

- Visualização de Dados: Proficiência em Looker Studio (Data Studio) para construção de relatórios e painéis automatizados e performáticos.

- Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos como Analista de Dados, com foco direto em Web Analytics e Big Data.


Requisitos diferenciais:

- Conhecimentos e experiência com a linguagem de modelagem Looker ML.

- Certificações oficiais Google.

- Familiaridade com Python para análise e manipulação de dados.


Interessados podem se candidatar pelo Linkedin ou enviar CV para

Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões baseada em dados em toda a organização.

Principais atividades:

- Liderar em Google Analytics (GA4):

- Gerenciar e otimizar totalmente a implementação e configuração do GA4, garantindo a mais alta qualidade e integridade dos dados de comportamento do usuário.

- Definir e manter o plano de mensuração completo (eventos, parâmetros, dimensões personalizadas) via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Governança de Dados via GCP/BigQuery:

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

Visualização e Comunicação:

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

A A2TM é uma corretora consultiva especializada no atendimento a empresas e organizações que buscam soluções de seguros com alto padrão técnico e suporte estratégico.

Relações pautadas pela ética, proximidade e alto valor de entrega são valores inegociáveis em nossa cultura de atuação.


Se você possui relacionamento com empresas que lidam com dados sensíveis, infraestrutura digital crítica ou operações expostas a riscos cibernéticos, esta pode ser uma grande oportunidade..

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Location : Brazil (Remote opportunity)


Join our team and start a new adventure in an international, dynamic, and highly regulated environment, where you can grow your career within a rapidly expanding organization.

Being a consultant at Amaris Consulting means positioning yourself as a technical and functional reference in Regulatory Affairs , acting as a strategic partner to our clients thanks to:

  • Your leadership and communication skills , enabling you to build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Your critical and regulatory mindset , allowing you to anticipate risks and propose solutions aligned with current regulations.
  • Your curiosity and continuous learning , supporting clients across multiple industries in complex regulatory contexts.

Your missions

  • Lead Regulatory Affairs activities for medical devices , ensuring compliance with European regulations (EU MDR – Regulation (EU) 2017/745).
  • Act as an expert in medical device classification , with a focus on Class IIa and IIb , ensuring correct application of classification rules.
  • Coordinate the preparation, review, and maintenance of technical documentation (EU MDR Annexes II and III).
  • Provide expert support in CE Marking processes and conformity assessments , including direct interaction with Notified Bodies .
  • Analyze and manage regulatory changes , assessing their impact on the product portfolio and defining regulatory strategies.
  • Advise quality, clinical, R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain teams on regulatory matters throughout the device lifecycle.
  • Lead responses to observations, questions, and non-conformities raised by health authorities and Notified Bodies.
  • Ensure compliance with post-market requirements , when applicable (PMS, PMCF, vigilance).
  • Propose and lead improvements in regulatory processes , optimizing timelines, documentation quality, and compliance.

Your profile

  • 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs for medical devices.
  • Proven experience with European regulations (EU MDR) .
  • Strong expertise in Class IIa and IIb medical devices .
  • Experience working with Notified Bodies and health authorities .
  • Solid knowledge of the regulatory lifecycle of medical devices (registration, maintenance, changes, and post-market activities).
  • Academic background in Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Health Sciences , or a related field.
  • Advanced / fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and prioritization skills .
  • Leadership, autonomy, and stakeholder management skills in international environments.


Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to diversity and to creating an inclusive work environment. We welcome all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic.

title: Senior Software Developer C#
description:
Software Developer / .net / C# / Microsoft technologies/ ASP / Designer / Software Engineer The Software Developer will work within a Development team, and may be involved in development of new products and maintenance of existing products including the design, installation, testing and maintenance of software systems


Senior Software Developer C#


What you’ll do


Participate in the migration and refactoring of a proxy solution from Golang to .NET, contributing to the evolution of legacy systems into modern architectures.

Design, develop and maintain cloud-native and edge computing solutions within the Restaurant Technology ecosystem.

Apply DevOps practices to cloud and edge deployments, including CI/CD automation.

Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and work closely with globally distributed engineering teams.

Ensure reliability, scalability and performance across both legacy and modern systems.

Understand complex existing systems and contribute to their continuous improvement.

Quickly learn and adapt to product and domain knowledge, supporting evolving business needs.



What we’re looking for


Solid experience with C# and .NET Core.

Experience working with cloud platforms and DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines.

Familiarity with edge computing environments and automated deployments.

Experience using gRPC for service-to-service communication.

Previous exposure to C++ is considered a plus.

Experience with Redis or similar in-memory data stores is a plus.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate in an international environment.

Good understanding of Agile methodologies and collaborative development practices.


Personal skill


Strong problem-solving and ownership mindset.

Ability to work independently and in global teams.

Execute for results

Team player profile

Prompted pressure

Know how to solve problems in an effective manner

Share knowledge


Open and clear communication


English Advanced (mandatory)

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: \"Analista de Infraestrutura Jr #992467\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atuação de nível 1

  • Conhecimento em redes de computadores.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de redes (VPN, IDS/IPS, firewalls).
  • Conhecimento em pacote office e ferramentas google.
  • Desejável conhecimento em elaboração de relatórios técnicos.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade de análise crítica.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias e implementar soluções
  • Conhecimento em produtos Cisco é um diferencial


Atuação remota

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Java para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços, trabalhando de forma próxima aos times internos e clientes.


Essa pessoa atuará no entendimento de requisitos, implementação de soluções técnicas, integrações e melhorias contínuas, sempre com foco em qualidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Analisar e compreender as necessidades e requisitos dos clientes, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com as equipes internas e os stakeholders para implementar soluções técnicas adequadas e inovadoras.
  • Desenvolver e documentar código de alta qualidade, seguindo padrões e melhores práticas de programação, utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas apropriadas para atender aos requisitos do projeto.
  • Participar do processo completo de desenvolvimento, desde o planejamento e análise até a programação, testes e implantação, garantindo a entrega de soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Colaborar com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e gerentes de projeto, compartilhando conhecimento e ajudando a solucionar problemas e encontrar soluções inovadoras.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com os membros da equipe e os stakeholders do projeto, fornecendo atualizações de progresso, discutindo desafios e soluções, e sendo capaz de responder a perguntas e resolver problemas conforme necessário.
  • Participar de revisões de código e reuniões de equipe, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e práticas de desenvolvimento da equipe.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor e desenvolvimentos tecnológicos, aplicando esse conhecimento no aprimoramento das soluções e na promoção da inovação contínua.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Sólida experiência com Java, Spring Boot, Spring Batch e arquitetura orientada a microsserviços
  • Experiência com AWS ou Azure, Docker, Kubernetes e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, Redis)
  • Domínio na criação e consumo de APIs RESTful para integração com sistemas legados e CRMs
  • Experiência com WhatsApp Business API (WABA) e provedores como Blip, Twilio ou MessageBird.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento em Python, especialmente para automações, integrações, jobs ou apoio a pipelines e serviços.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;

title: Business Leaders (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, Director, VP, Department Head and Senior Manager .



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, Head of Department and Senior Manager.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: System Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of the largest TV providers in North America. We are looking for VMWare Administrator to maintain security, performance monitoring, Installing, configuring, securing, managing, and monitoring VMware vSphere ESXi clusters in multiple data centers.


Responsibilities:

  • Installation, configuration, maintenance, tuning and troubleshooting of VMware environment running on vSphere 6.5, 6.7, 7, 8.
  • Installation of ESXi Host and vCenter Server
  • Upgrading ESXi
  • Responsible for ESXI Host Server Health Check and Performance Monitoring
  • Experience working with VCF, vCenter, vSphere, vROPs
  • Upgrade VM Tools and VM Hardware versions
  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • - Server Hardware Management
  • - Virtualization, especially VMware
  • - Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP
  • - Security, including best practices, patch management, vulnerability assessments
  • - Monitoring and Troubleshooting


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Senior Software Engineer


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You’ll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.


Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.


Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.


Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


Are you passionate about building scalable data platforms and cutting-edge MLOps solutions? Do you want to work with a top-tier US company revolutionizing e-commerce and circular fashion?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong MLOps expertise to join our growing data engineering team. This is a full-time , 100% remote opportunity exclusive to candidates located in Brazil . You'll be working with a fast-paced US-based company, leading innovations in sustainable commerce and data-driven operations.


What You’ll Do


  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data infrastructure across real-time and batch workloads.
  • Build and support ML pipelines for model training, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to deliver high-performance data and ML solutions.
  • Develop APIs and services for data ingestion, transformation, and querying.
  • Ensure the reliability of ML systems through strong observability and operational tools.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and mentor team members.


Tech Stack & Requirements


  • 5+ years as a Data Engineer or MLOps Engineer.
  • Strong experience with Python , Java , or Scala .
  • Hands-on with GCP (preferred), AWS or Azure .
  • Experience with BigQuery , ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Apache Kafka , Spark , or similar tools is a big plus.
  • Experience with ETL , CI/CD , git , and monitoring pipelines .
  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English (written & spoken) is mandatory .
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related fields.


What We Offer


  • Top-tier hourly rate paid in USD
  • Long-term contract opportunity
  • Fully remote work – collaborate with international teams from the comfort of your home
  • A high-impact role within a data-driven, mission-oriented company

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior (Foco em Backend)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior (Foco em Backend)


Remoto

Inglês intermediário


Responsabilidades

Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções Full Stack, com predominância em Backend, participando das fases de entendimento de requisitos, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação e implementação. Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e microsserviços em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance, segurança e escalabilidade. Apoiar tecnicamente o time, contribuindo com organização das atividades, revisão de código e boas práticas. Atuar em integrações sistêmicas e ambientes de missão crítica.


Conhecimentos Técnicos Obrigatórios

Java 8+ / Java 11+

Spring Boot e ecossistema Spring

Arquitetura de microsserviços

APIs REST e integrações sistêmicas

Mensageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ ou similares)

Banco de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL ou MySQL)

Versionamento com Git e práticas de CI/CD


Conhecimentos Desejáveis

Front-end com React ou Angular

Cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure)

Docker e Kubernetes

Observabilidade e monitoramento (Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus)

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

  • Excellent English communication skills

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Consultor Técnico em Vendas
description:
CONSULTOR TÉCNICO EM VENDAS


Segmento: Movimentação e Içamento de Cargas


Profissional com forte perfil Técnico Comercial, responsável por realizar o atendimento consultivo a clientes no segmento de movimentação e içamento de cargas. Atua na identificação de necessidades, especificação de produtos (lingas de corrente, cintas, manilhas, dispositivos mecânicos, entre outros), elaboração de propostas comerciais e acompanhamento de projetos junto aos clientes.


Possuir domínio técnico sobre os produtos comercializados, normas de segurança e aplicação prática em campo. Atuar com foco em resultados, relacionamento com clientes e soluções sob medida para demandas industriais.


Principais Competências:


• Sólido conhecimento técnico em equipamentos de içamento e movimentação de cargas

• Experiência em vendas consultivas e relacionamento B2B

• Habilidade em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e especificações normativas

• Facilidade em negociações comerciais e acompanhamento de pós-venda

• Boa comunicação, postura consultiva e foco em soluções

• Proatividade e autonomia na gestão de carteira de clientes


Requisitos:


• Formação técnica ou superior em áreas correlatas (Mecânica, Logística, Engenharia, etc.)

• Conhecimento prático das normas de segurança aplicáveis 

• CNH categoria B e disponibilidade para viagens frequentes, inclusive interestaduais

• Desejável vivência em campo (visitas técnicas, inspeções e demonstrações práticas)


Diferenciais:


• Experiência com treinamentos técnicos ou suporte pós-venda

• Atuação anterior em empresas fornecedoras de equipamentos industriais ou soluções de elevação

• Experiência prévia com lingas, acessórios de içamento e dispositivos de movimentação


Salário e benefícios à combinar

title: Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Planejar, desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e monitorar modelos de Machine Learning, utilizando abordagens clássicas, NLP/NLI e LLMs;
  • Conduzir experimentações, provas de conceito (PoCs) e iniciativas de Discovery que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a automação de processos;
  • Explorar e analisar dados de negócio, realizando análises diagnósticas, preditivas e prescritivas;
  • Avaliar, estimar e acompanhar custos de implementação e operação em escala das soluções propostas;
  • Criar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações para comunicar resultados, insights e impactos dos projetos;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, alinhando expectativas e defendendo boas práticas técnicas;
  • Propor inovações, apoiar decisões técnicas e contribuir para a evolução contínua das soluções de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Python avançado, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pydantic, PyTorch e TensorFlow;
  • SQL intermediário a avançado, com atuação em bancos de dados relacionais;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Machine Learning, incluindo técnicas de regressão, classificação, clustering e NLP;
  • Experiência com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo BERT, ASR, RAG, fine-tuning e modelos generativos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com frameworks e APIs de ML e GenAI, como HuggingFace, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, DSPy, LangGraph, Vertex AI.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!
