title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior - Node.js
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior – Node.js (PIX) para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e criticidade, dentro de um ambiente financeiro robusto, dinâmico e orientado à excelência técnica.


Você fará parte de um time altamente qualificado, responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar sistemas críticos de meios de pagamento , com forte foco em performance, segurança, escalabilidade e qualidade das entregas . Esse profissional atuará como referência técnica , contribuindo ativamente para decisões arquiteturais, definição de boas práticas e mentoria do time.


Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados, com interação constante entre Backend, Frontend, QA, UI/UX, Analistas de Sistemas e PO de negócio. Valorizamos autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais atividades:


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e implantação de sistemas backend utilizando Node.js , seguindo boas práticas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Desenvolver APIs RESTful robustas, seguras e escaláveis, com foco em PIX e sistemas financeiros .
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microserviços , containers (Docker ) e esteiras automatizadas de CI/CD .
  • Realizar análises técnicas de demandas negociais e evolutivas, em conjunto com analistas de sistemas e times de negócio.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica , performance e segurança dos sistemas em produção e homologação.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e arquitetural dos sistemas.
  • Atuar na mentoria técnica da equipe , apoiando boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes e arquitetura.
  • Contribuir para a evolução contínua da arquitetura e dos padrões técnicos adotados no CCS (MDS).

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas de tecnologia


Competências esperadas:


  • Node.js com Express (ES6 ou superior).
  • Arquitetura de software , princípios RESTful e padrões de projeto.
  • MongoDB (incluindo consultas complexas com aggregate) e bancos relacionais (SQL).
  • Mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ ou similares).
  • Testes unitários e de integração , qualidade de código e ferramentas como Sonar.
  • Versionamento com Git e GitFlow .
  • CI/CD (Jenkins, Sonar, pipelines automatizados).
  • Programação orientada a objetos, funcional e reativa .
  • Clean Code e Refactoring .
  • Experiência com PIX , setor financeiro ou meios de pagamento.

Diferencial para a vaga:


  • Experiência em sistemas financeiros, bancários ou de alto volume transacional
  • Conhecimento em segurança da informação e LGPD .

Informações adicionais

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS


Alguns dos nossos benefícios são flexíveis para que você possa distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades, interesses e momento de vida. São eles:


  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens);
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível e Uber, 99);
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação, shows e outros);
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação.

Outros benefícios:


  • Birthday off;
  • Gympass;
  • Consultoria financeira e empréstimo facilitado;
  • Clube Alelo com diversos descontos em lojas e farmácias;
  • Licença Maternidade de 180 dias;
  • Licença Paternidade de 30 dias;
  • Auxílio creche no primeiro ano do bebê;
  • Vale Transporte conforme a demanda do projeto ou área;
  • Comissionamento por indicação de novos clientes.

Our ERP / CRM coverage includes: SAP, Oracle EBS/Fusion, Oracle Cloud ERP, Peoplesoft, JDE, Infor (M3, LX, XA, LN, System 21), IFS, Epicor, SysPro, D365 & Salesforce.

One of our longest standing service verticals has been assisting transition clients from legacy systems to cloud based platforms including introduction of Cloud / GenAI and MS-Fabric, RAG models.


We are seeking a multiple Civil Engineers with emphasis on Load analysis: Structural conditions of rooftops/framing systems.

English language proficiency is mandatory.


These are remote roles.


This is a Civil Engineering client who are a market leader in the renewable energy industry. Ideally, they would like to start someone by early February for 11 months with an option to extend annually.

ROLES:

1) Civil Engineers (3+ years of experience)

2) Associate Civil Engineer: ACE (0-3 years of experience)


Executive Summary

Our client is dedicated to maintaining high-volume production speeds without compromising the rigorous structural safety and code compliance standards required for a 25-year system life. We require a scalable solution where a vendor-managed team can execute technical reviews, resolve engineering escalations, and maintain seamless communication across our design-to-installation pipeline.


Primary Duties

  • Reviewing structural conditions of rooftops and framing systems
  • Designing or verifying the configuration of racking and attachment systems
  • Performing load analysis to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards and expected performance over a 25-year system life
  • Working in a high-volume production environment, completing multiple project assessments per day, with some engineers averaging multiple evaluations per hour
  • The ability to maintain accuracy and consistency at scale is critical.

  • Turnaround Times: Core tasks are measured in business hours with expectations ranging from 4 to 24 hours depending on the task type.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in an engineering discipline, with preference for civil or structural engineering

  • Proficiency in technical analysis and structural design tools is a plus but not required
  • Strong English communication skills for coordination with US-based engineering leads


Experience level

  • Associate Civil Engineer-ACE: 0–3 years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field
  • Civil Engineer: 3+ years of relevant experience, ideal for early-career engineers seeking growth in a specialized field

title: Backend Developer Mid-level (JAVA)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

#


O que esperar do seu dia a dia:

Buscamos um profissional Backend Java com fluência em inglês para contribuir ativamente com o time. Contrato inicial de 3 meses para atuação no projeto, com possibilidade de prorrogação. A atuação envolve desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções backend utilizando JAVA. Oportunidade global de crescimento, com interação constante e troca de experiências com times diversos e internacionais!


O que você precisa ter:

  • Expertise em Java (JDK 8+), Spring Boot, Hibernate e multithreading.
  • SQL e Gerenciamento de Bancos de Dados – Sólido conhecimento em SQL, bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) e técnicas de otimização.
  • Microserviços e Desenvolvimento de APIs – Experiência no desenho de APIs RESTful e atuação com arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Otimização de Performance – Proficiência em indexação de banco de dados, otimização de queries, uso de cache (Redis, Memcached) e ajuste da JVM.

title: Recruiter Assistant
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remote


At Blue Dot BPO , we connect top LATAM talent with high-performance executive teams at U.S.-based companies. We are looking for a Recruiter Assistant with excellent English communication skills, strong organization, and a proactive mindset to support high-volume recruiting operations.


This is a fully remote role focused on the U.S. market, offering daily exposure to global teams and a clear growth path for those who want to build a career in recruitment.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$4,000
  • 100% remote , working directly with U.S.-based recruiting teams
  • Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (executive recruiting, leadership, or management)
  • International networking and a multicultural environment
  • Paid training and structured onboarding


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the client’s U.S.-based recruiting team in sourcing and pre-qualifying candidates
  • Conduct initial screenings via phone calls, emails, and messages
  • Keep databases updated (job boards and ATS)
  • Write and update job descriptions and candidate profiles
  • Source talent through job boards and resume databases
  • Manage calendars and support communication flow between candidates and recruiters
  • Assist with administrative tasks related to recruitment operations and team organization


What We’re Looking For

  • Advanced English (C1), strong written and spoken communication required
  • Highly organized, focused, and able to manage multiple priorities
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in recruitment or talent acquisition
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS platforms
  • Experience in high-volume recruiting environments with tight deadlines


Technical Requirements

  • Two monitors | i5 / i7 processor (or equivalent) | 12GB+ RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone and a quiet workspace


Build Your Career in Recruitment

If you want to work directly with U.S. teams, gain valuable recruiting experience, and grow fast in a structured and performance-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer (Webflow + WordPress)
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.



What You’ll Do


  • Design and develop responsive, visually engaging websites in Webflow and WordPress .
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Translate approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow or WordPress.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Ensure all designs follow UX/UI best practices , accessibility standards, and performance guidelines.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress .
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds .
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS , and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.



Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.



Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST , Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Visual Effects Artist
description:
Who we are:


Apex Systems is a leading professional services organization focused on providing solutions with real business value. We provide a customer-focused approach to building authentic partnerships with our clients.


We are seeking a VFX Artist to join the team supporting an international world-wide gaming client and the next‑generation evolution of the franchise

This role will focus on real‑time VFX for core gameplay and visuals, helping deliver next‑gen quality while meeting sprint‑based production needs.


We’re looking for someone with a strong sense of dramatic, dynamic visual effects, a critical eye for timing and motion, and the technical ability to bring these effects to life inside Unreal Engine.

You’ll work closely with a small, collaborative team, contribute to a mix of styles ranging from stylized to ESPN‑inspired sports broadcast polish, and help push the Client's visuals forward.


In This Role, You Will:


  • Execute high‑quality real‑time VFX for the client.
  • Create all necessary art for visual effects, including concepts, prototypes, textures, materials, and final in‑game FX.
  • Develop effects across a wide range of styles, from realistic to stylized, with an emphasis on high‑energy gameplay readability.
  • Contribute to next‑gen arena visuals, gameplay moments (flips, jumps, boosts, grabs), and new core‑loop effects.
  • Work within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven systems.
  • Collaborate with engineers, artists, and designers to ensure FX integrate smoothly into gameplay and pipelines.
  • Support sprint deliverables and production deadlines leading up to major milestones.


About the Project:


This role helps support Project Coronado, a next‑gen porting of the core Gaming experience, with:


  • Updated visuals for arenas and core gameplay elements.
  • A shift toward ESPN-style, sports-broadcast-inspired VFX, with less traditional arcade styling.
  • A focus on scripting-heavy FX behaviors and technical implementation.
  • No cosmetics work — purely gameplay and core experience.
  • August delivery milestones requiring additional mid‑level VFX support.


Day-to-Day Responsibilities


  • Primarily execution-focused work rather than high-concept ideation.
  • Implementing technical FX solutions using Blueprints, shaders, logic systems, and materials.
  • Creating textures and materials as needed to support FX systems.
  • Working cross-functionally with a small, agile team.
  • Contributing to a live service pipeline with frequent iteration and updates.


Requirements


  • Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating high-quality real-time VFX.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred).
  • Experience with Blueprints, materials, shaders, and logic-driven FX.
  • Solid technical background paired with strong artistic instincts.
  • Experience working on live service or active production projects.
  • Ability to create all components needed for VFX (textures, meshes, materials, prototypes).
  • Strong sense of timing, weight, animation principles, and motion.
  • Eager to keep learning.


Nice to have


  • Experience with Call of Duty–style FX sensibilities (timing, punch, clarity).
  • Strong animation fundamentals — especially movement, impact, and timing.
  • Experience shipping multiple titles in the game industry.
  • Desire to grow pipelines, tools, and collaborative processes.

Hi,

Please find the below Job Opportunity.

Title: DocuSign CLM Consultant

Length of Assignment : 12 months Contract

Location: Remote

Client: Oxford/Alcoa client

Open to Candidates In: United States and Brazil

Time Zone: Primarily EST; may also support BRT (±1 hour)

Language: English required; Spanish or Portuguese is a plus

Role Overview

We are seeking a DocuSign CLM Consultant to support sales and procurement digital transformation initiatives. This role will focus on new project implementations and enhancements, as well as ongoing support, troubleshooting, and resolution of ServiceNow support requests.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong technical and functional experience with DocuSign CLM
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with DocuSign Insight (AI)

title: Senior Dotnet Developer(.NET DEVELOPER)
description:
Title: .NET Developer

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Job Specific Responsibilities:

Responsibilities:

● Be responsible for monitoring and troubleshooting Kofax, DSP, E2E reporting and Webstatus .net applications based on SQL server , deployed on Windows Server IIS.

● Work on incidents, requests and problem tickets

● Manage production deployments

● Manage major incidents

● Monitor Jobs and remediate any failures

● Communicate and coordinate issue status effectively with users


Qualifications

Competencies

● Technical Skills and Proficiency

o 5 to 7 years of Software experience, with a minimum of 4 years in .Net and SQL

o Must have experience in

o ASP.NET using C#, .NET Fx 4.0/ 3.5, JavaScript, MVC 4, WCF, Web Services, HTML 5, CSS, JQuery, Java Script.

o Extensive experience with Windows 10, Server 2016/2022, SQL Database, Advanced IIS and Active Directory.

o Knowledge in IIS apppool management, powershell, webfarming(load balancing),High availability (clustering)

o Analyzing IIS and Windows event logs to diagnose application, configuration, or server issues, performance monitoring

o Experience in TCP/IP and in troubleshooting Network Issues. Network management and basic knowledge of switches, routers and firewalls

o IDE & Tools: VS 2017/ 2019, GIT/GITLab

o Good to Have (Optional)

Programming: VB.Net, Ext JS. XAML

Microsoft Certified Professional (or related certification)

A+ and Network+ Certifications

Responsibilities

o Responsible for developing scalable and high-performing components.

o Should be a good team player

o Ability to work independently and proactively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

o Provide technical leadership to teammates through coaching and mentorship

o Timely software delivery as per set standards

o Performing unit and integration testing

o Communicating changes to documentation and QA teams

o Experience in Agile development methodology and Scrum

o Identify and encourage areas for growth and improvement within the team.

o Collaborate with other software developers, business analysts and software architects to plan,

title: Product implementer / DTP freelancer
description:
Do you like mixing creativity with technical skills?

Do you have experience in DTP or a desire to learn it?

BubblyDoo is looking for a hands-on freelance full remote Product Implementer to join our team ASAP on a full time basis.


You will kick off with Mother's Day, and Father’s Day books for our in-house products, but also for various licensing partners (such as Peppa Pig from Hasbro, PAW Patrol from Paramount, Barbie from Mattel, and more!). You will support the launch of new personalized children’s books and products, working closely with our in-house team and software developer.


What you’ll do

  • Use various in-house tools like our Translation Tool and Product Builder to fully implement the translations and our books
  • Prepare and configure our CMS for each new launch
  • Have direct contact with our translators, illustrators and editors for quality review and product improvements
  • Support with organizing Photoshop files to ensure all visual assets are ready for production


What we’re looking for

  • Full time or part time availability from February 2026, with an initial onboarding and training phase, for the first few months.
  • Strong communication skills in an international environment
  • A feeling for design but also technically strong
  • Comfortable using internal tools and learning quickly
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and structured


What’s in it for you

  • Join a small, young, and passionate team that cares deeply about what we create
  • Take ownership and responsibility for the quality of our product line
  • Compensation of $1500/month (usd)


For questions or more information about the role, don’t hesitate to reach out to


Looking forward to connect and to a great collaboration!

title: Private Equity Professional — AI Research
description:
We are looking for experienced private equity and finance professionals to support frontier AI research focused on institutional-grade financial analysis, modeling, and investment decision systems.


This role is ideal for professionals with a deal-driven background who want to apply their judgment, pattern recognition, and modeling experience to the development of advanced AI tools used in real investment workflows.


Why Apply

  • Competitive Pay: Benefit from attractive hourly rates and potential performance-based incentives
  • Impactful Work: Play a key role in advancing AI capabilities within a forward-thinking, Founders Fund-backed startup
  • Flexible Environment: Enjoy the freedom of remote, asynchronous work that adapts to your schedule while contributing to groundbreaking technology


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of professional experience
  • Availability: 18–40 hours/week (flexible)
  • Minimum commitment: 1 month, with the option to continue long-term


Expertise

  • Strong command of GAAP and financial statement analysis
  • Advanced Excel-based financial modeling (LBOs, operating models, scenario analysis)
  • Hands-on experience evaluating companies, transactions, or investments
  • Background in private equity, private credit, structured finance, or investment banking preferred


Engagement Details

  • Fully remote
  • Ongoing, research-driven work at the intersection of finance and AI


Compensation

  • $30-35 USD per hour

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


\"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders\"

description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir em Campo Grande/MS.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Sap Advanced Business Application Programming Consultant
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for \"SAP ABAP Odata\" Remote in Brazil who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Prototype, design, develop, and maintain Mobile Application Integration Framework and its integration services to support mobile applications such as SAP Service and Asset Manager, SAP Maintenance Assistant, as well as other system-to-system integration scenarios such as S/4HANA and Asset Performance Management solution integration, S/4HANA Disconnected Defense, S/4HANA Last Mile Delivery, S/4HANA and Business Network Asset Collaboration solution integration etc.

Follow SAP’s development standard, efficient use of SAP ABAP programming model and development tools in development and testing, such as ABAP OO, ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model, BAPI, BAdI, Open SQL, RDBMS, SAPGUI, ABAP Development Tools for Eclipse, Web Dynpro for ABAP, Fiori Elements, SAP Gateway, OData Service, S/4HANA Private Cloud, S/4HAN Public Cloud, SAP ERP system etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, integration feature requirement

Setup and configure necessary S/4HANA system business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), setup necessary test data (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), to support the development and test of integration services.

Collaborate with UX designers to ensure seamless and visually appealing user experience following SAP Fiori Design Guidelines when relevant.

Ensure high performance and responsiveness of developed features

Actively collaborate with frontend MDK developers to align on OData Service features and requirement, to ensure seamless integration between frontend and backend.

Conduct thorough testing, including ABAP unit test to fulfill code coverage requirement, backward compatibility, and prevent performance and feature regression with any new development and enhancement.

Actively collaborate with quality engineers on issues reported, debug, identify and fix bugs, short dumps, and performance issues

Provide sufficient documentations on features developed

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) to provide information on product features developed to be used in product documentation

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Participate in backlog grooming, and able to provide good quality effort estimates

Provide quick investigation and resolution to assigned customer incident from ServiceNow. Follow standard customer incident support process, ensure timely investigation, proper communication with customer, proper documentation in ServicewNow incident, and resolution of issues within standard SLA based on criticality of the customer incident. Create necessary JIRA issue for tracking, and SAP Note to provide resolution and fixes.

Maintain communication and documentation in English

Maintain proper communication and notification with lead ABAP developer and SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Somos uma empresa atuante na construção de casas populares (Minha Casa Minha Vida) , regularização de imóveis e desenvolvimento de loteamentos residenciais , oferecendo soluções completas em engenharia, planejamento urbano e organização técnica para viabilizar moradia acessível.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a) para atuar no modelo híbrido , em Belém/PA , apoiando a equipe técnica e administrativa da empresa.

A vaga é ideal para quem possui conhecimento básico em AutoCAD , interesse na área de construção civil e deseja aprender, na prática, sobre projetos, documentação técnica e rotina administrativa de obras e loteamentos.

  • Apoio na elaboração e ajustes de projetos em AutoCAD ;
  • Auxílio na confecção de memoriais descritivos , mapas de localização e documentos técnicos;
  • Organização e atualização de planilhas de obra e controles administrativos;

  • Organização de documentos e apoio em processos de regularização e obras;
  • Apoio presencial quando necessário, conforme rotina da equipe.

  • Conhecimento básico em AutoCAD ;
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (Excel e Word);
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalho em equipe;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida em Belém/PA ;
  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver profissionalmente.
Diferenciais
  • Interesse por construção civil, habitação popular e urbanismo;
  • Noções iniciais de documentação técnica e obras;
  • Proatividade e comprometimento.

  • Cargo: Estagiário(a) / Assistente Técnico(a)

title: Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer
description:
Tech Lead Machine Learning/Data Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Work with a high skilled team to leverage complex and high quality machine learning and statistical models;
  • Implement model to service integration via DAG creations and ETL processes;
  • Evaluate model performance under real data testing results and remodelate accordingly;
  • Build scalable models and DAGs to enable new workflows creations in a high-usage, high-demand environment;
  • Work with worldwide multidisciplinary distributed team, participate in technical discussions and definitions using English as main communication language;
  • Leverage accurate model architecture and documentation.

Essential Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related areas;
  • Desire to combine theory and abilities to solve problems pragmatically, applying Machine Learning techniques and integrating them into larger systems;

  • Knowledge in probability and statistical modeling;
  • Hands-on experience in statistical analysis and Machine Learning modeling using Python;
  • Hands-on experience on model evaluation, integration, data transformation and deployment, covering the complete end-to-end cycle;

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Python notebooks, pandas;
  • Experience with PySpark, Airflow;

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
Our US client, is seeking a leader for their Product Development team. This team builds business-critical applications that support customers across the global food and beverage supply chain. They need a hands-on Software Engineering Manager for their Brazil Delivery Center to lead and grow a .NET development team. You will be responsible for recruiting, mentoring, and managing top talent, ensuring high performance and continuous professional growth.


Job Duties:

People & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a remote team of full-stack software engineers, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching and feedback, and support career development for team members.
  • Partner with Product Management, QA, DevOps, and other global engineering teams to plan and deliver cloud features aligned with customer migration needs.
  • Own delivery outcomes for the SaaS platform, ensuring predictable, high-quality releases and effective post–go-live support.
  • Participate in hiring and onboarding of new engineers as the team continues to scale.
  • Hands-On Technical Leadership
  • Contribute to the design, development, and maintenance of a SaaS application using the same tools and practices as the engineering team.
  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure.
  • Support front-end development using HTML and TypeScript.
  • Review code, guide architectural decisions, and ensure adherence to coding standards, security best practices, and performance requirements.
  • Leverage AI-powered developer tools and assistants to improve code quality, reduce repetitive work, and accelerate delivery.


Engineering Excellence

  • Promote best practices in software architecture, testing, CI/CD, and DevOps.
  • Ensure appropriate monitoring, logging, and operational readiness using tools such as Application Insights and Kusto.
  • Identify and drive continuous improvement initiatives across development processes and team workflows.


Qualifications:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 3+ years of experience leading or managing software engineers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
  • .NET / C# for RESTful API development
  • TypeScript / JavaScript and modern web application development
  • SQL databases (Azure SQL or similar)
  • Experience building and operating cloud-based applications on Microsoft Azure.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and secure application development.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred

  • YAML-based infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience using AI APIs or AI-assisted development tools (Cursor or similar).


This role is CRT and starts at R$20,000/Month

title: Data Scientist  [Operational Research] - [Banco de Talentos]
description:
Estamos formando um Banco de Talentos para profissionais de Data Science com especialização em Pesquisa Operacional .

O objetivo é identificar talentos para futuras oportunidades voltadas ao desenvolvimento de soluções inteligentes baseadas em dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Implementar o modelo de Pesquisa Operacional, seguindo a especificação técnica definida;

Especificar o método/algoritmo/técnica de Pesquisa Operacional a ser utilizado, considerando o porte típico das instâncias do problema;

Validar a especificação técnica do método/algoritmo de Pesquisa Operacional junto ao cliente responsável;

Gerar relatórios com os resultados da solução do modelo, utilizando o conhecimento dos contratos;

Desenvolver o código do método de Pesquisa Operacional em Python, conforme a especificação aprovada.


Requisitos e qualificações

Conhecimento em modelos matemáticos de Pesquisa Operacional (modelos de programação matemática inteira mista);

Conhecimento avançado em Python nas bibliotecas pandas, openxl, pyinstaller, entre outras;

Conhecimento na biblioteca pyomo para implementação de modelos de PO;

Conhecimento nos solvers HiGHS e GLPK.

Desejáveis: Conhecimento em contratos de transporte de gás natural.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Onebridge, uma empresa Marlabs, é uma consultoria global de IA e Análise de Dados que capacita organizações em todo o mundo a alcançar melhores resultados por meio de dados e tecnologia. Desde 2005, fazemos parceria com algumas das maiores entidades dos setores de saúde, ciências da vida, serviços financeiros e governo em todo o mundo. Temos uma oportunidade empolgante para um(a) Líder de Engenharia de Software altamente qualificado(a) se juntar à nossa equipe inovadora e dinâmica.


Tipo de Contrato : Tempo Integral

Localização : Brasil – Remoto

Indústria : TI & Serviços


Esta posição exige habilidades avançadas de comunicação em inglês, tanto escrita quanto verbal.


Lead Software Engineer | Sobre Você

Como Lead Software Engineer, você é responsável por impulsionar a visão técnica por trás de aplicações modernas e escaláveis, enquanto orienta uma equipe de engenharia de alta performance. Você prospera na interseção entre arquitetura, desenvolvimento prático e mentoria, equilibrando decisões estratégicas com a paixão por construir software de excelência.

Você gosta de definir padrões de engenharia, elevar as capacidades da equipe e tomar decisões conscientes que influenciam o sucesso do produto a longo prazo.

É motivado(a) por resolver desafios técnicos complexos e criar ambientes onde os engenheiros possam realizar o seu melhor trabalho.


Lead Software Engineer | Atividades do Dia a Dia

title: Application Support- Dynatrace (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Gen AI Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Proven 2+ end-to-end MCP-based agent orchestration implementations.

Strong expertise in Python, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

Experienced Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy scalable multi-agent systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP)

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years as an AI Engineer delivering multiple production-grade AI solutions, and at least 2 complete end-to-end AI/MCP-based orchestration projects, including knowledge of benchmarking and guardrails.


You will lead the design and integration of LLM-driven agents, build modular toolchains, and ensure seamless orchestration across enterprise-grade research applications.


Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), API integration, and LLM orchestration.


Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and monitoring AI pipelines.


Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-disciplinary research environment.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Childcare assistance

Gympass

title: Tech Recruiter
description:
Atividades:

• Atrair, identificar e triar profissionais por meio da busca ativa nas ferramentas de recrutamento, que atendam aos requisitos técnicos e comportamentais das vagas abertas;

• Estabelecer contato com os candidatos, para apresentar a empresa, os benefícios da posição e os desafios envolvidos no trabalho, promovendo o interesse desses candidatos em participar do processo seletivo;

• Preparar o resumo do candidato com currículo e parecer de entrevista para envio ao Comercial/Cliente;

• Conduzir entrevistas, aplicar testes ou outras técnicas de avaliação, quando necessário;

• Levantar informações sobre a experiência e as referências profissionais dos candidatos para avaliar seu histórico de desempenho e verificar sua aderência frente à cultura e valores da empresa;

• Utilizar habilidades de negociação para identificar as expectativas e necessidades do candidato em relação a sua posição atual e à oferta da empresa;

• Apresentar de forma clara os benefícios da vaga, incluindo possibilidades de desenvolvimento profissional, desafios e oportunidades de crescimento.

• Agendar e participar de entrevistas com clientes, realizar propostas, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de RH e áreas afins;

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;

• Experiência em vagas de tecnologia ou atuação prévia em consultoria de R&S com foco em TI;

• Familiaridade com vocabulário técnico;

• Habilidades desenvolvidas de persuasão, engajamento e empatia.

• Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Maringá/PR.

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.


#SeleçãoSBF #vempraSBF

title: Analytics Engineer - Especialista I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Garante o self-service e acesso à informação através de modelagens de tabelas e métricas coesas, escaláveis e de alto impacto, construindo pipelines robustos, resilientes e de referência técnica para a tribo;
  • Atua como referência na detecção, prevenção e solução de problemas complexos relacionados à disciplina de dados, propondo soluções definitivas e escaláveis que eliminem a recorrência de falhas;
  • Lidera iniciativas estratégicas de dados da tribo, desde o planejamento até a entrega, garantindo alinhamento entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, e promovendo excelência na tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Realiza análises críticas do que está sendo desenvolvido, avaliando impacto, qualidade e reuso por outros times, tanto do ponto de vista de dados quanto de negócio;
  • Propõe e implementa melhorias contínuas em processos de dados, orquestrando stakeholders e fomentando boas práticas que elevem o nível de maturidade analítica da organização;
  • Atua como mentor(a) e referência técnica para analistas de outros níveis, disseminando conhecimento e boas práticas.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em programação (preferencialmente Python), com aplicação prática em automação, análise avançada e engenharia de dados
  • Domínio em modelagem de dados (conceitual, lógica e física), com experiência comprovada em ambientes complexos e de grande escala;
  • Excelência em SQL, capaz de desenvolver consultas altamente otimizadas e escaláveis;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI e Looker Studio preferencialmente), com capacidade de estruturar dashboards estratégicos e narrativas de dados de alto impacto;
  • Noções em ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines (Ex. Airflow ou equivalentes);
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua;
  • Capacidade comprovada de liderar projetos cross-times, influenciar decisões estratégicas e atuar como ponto focal técnico em fóruns executivos e de negócio.

description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de sistemas .NET Core, integrando práticas avançadas de IA Generativa ao fluxo de trabalho.

Atuação em Arquitetura: Papel colaborativo na definição de arquitetura (execução pelo time do cliente) e forte atuação na estipulação de diretrizes e boas práticas de código.

Competências Desejáveis:

Experiência no uso e disseminação de metodologias (AI Champion) e ferramentas baseadas em IA, como Cursor, Devin e GitHub Copilot, com o objetivo de otimizar o SDLC (automação, testes, refatoração) e aplicar prompt engineering

Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquiteturas de microsserviços baseados em eventos

Liderança e Gestão: mentoria técnica da equipe, resolução de desafios complexos, garantia da qualidade via code reviews e gestão de prazos de entrega.

Experiência e habilidade na tradução de requisitos de negócio para especificações técnicas e alinhamento de expectativas com o cliente.

Requisitos Técnicos: .NET 6/7/8+, Microsserviços, DDD, Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) e Bancos de Dados SQL/NoSQL.

Experiência em liderança ágil, mínimo de 3-5 anos, com boa capacidade de negociação/comunicação interna e com o cliente.


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Desejavel conhecimentos: Microsoft Azure, .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, API REST, Containers Kuvernetes, CI/CD GitLab e GitOps, Message Queuing : Red Hat AMQ para mensageria.

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .

Location: Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelors (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em automação inteligente com Inteligência Artificial, com atuação de ponta a ponta, da arquitetura à implementação em produção. Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.


O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.


O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.


Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.


Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.


Seja qual for o seu gênero, orientação sexual, idade, raça, etnia, crença ou deficiência, todos são bem-vindos no nosso time.


Responsabilidades Principais


Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de automação com IA, integradas a ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).


Desenvolver, treinar e evoluir agentes autônomos e assistentes virtuais utilizando LLMs, LangChain, RAG, MCP Server e Google Agentspace.


Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para alimentar modelos de IA e fluxos automatizados.


Integrar bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL e vetoriais.


Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Python e PHP.


Aplicar engenharia de prompt e arquiteturas multi-agentes em ambientes produtivos.


Desenvolver interfaces front-end leves para monitoramento e controle das automações.


Orquestrar ambientes de Cloud e DevOps com Docker, Git e pipelines CI/CD.


Garantir governança, compliance e rastreabilidade no uso de IA (versionamento de prompts, documentação e observabilidade).


Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)


Inglês avançado

Experiência sólida em automação inteligente com IA


Vivência com LLMs e frameworks de IA (LangChain, RAG, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)


Experiência com ferramentas de automação: n8n, Power Automate, Make ou Zapier


Desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js e/ou Python


Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços e integração de sistemas


Experiência com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP)


Stack Técnica Desejável

IA & LLMs


OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, LangChain, RAG, Banco de Dados Vetorial, MCP Server


Automação & Orquestração


n8n, Power Automate, Make, Zapier


Agentes Autônomos, Engenharia de Prompt


Back-End


Node.js, Python, PHP


Front-End


ReactJS, Bootstrap, JavaScript


Cloud & DevOps


Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


Git (GitHub / Bitbucket), Docker, CI/CD


Banco de Dados


SQL Server, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL


Ferramentas Complementares


Postman, Grafana, Kibana, AI Search


Terraform (diferencial)


Diferenciais

Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud e híbridos.


Integrações com CRM, ERP e Martech (Salesforce, SAP BTP, RD Station, HubSpot).


Certificações em Cloud ou IA (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).


Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em fluxos automatizados mensuráveis.


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido (1x por semana presencial) no endereço: Vila Nova Conceição, São Paulo/SP


Perfil Comportamental

Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural.


Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.


Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade.


Interesse contínuo por inovação e evolução em IA.

Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.


O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.


O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.


Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.


Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.

Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Scrum master who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

SAFe; Scrum; Kanban; jira; Agile

Familiarity with Scrum and Agile methodologies;

Basic knowledge of project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello) is an advantage;

Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts and experience with applications hosted in cloud environments is preferred;

Eager to learn and grow in project management and cloud technology areas;

Advanced proficiency in English

Certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) is a plus but not required.

Should have worked at least 2-3 years as a Scrum Master;

Very good in Communication(English);

Experience in Project Management will be added advantage;

Should able to manage multiple Scrum Calls and Teams together;

Good understanding Consumer retail Business;

Well versed with Jira.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Remote – Brazil)
description:
About the job


Company: Hitch

Location: Remote (5+ hours overlap with San Francisco PST required. South America preferred.)

Position: Full-Time


About HitchHitch is a fast-growing fintech building the digital rails for home equity lending. We power lenders like Deephaven and MyEQNow, helping them originate and scale HELOCs, Home Equity Investments, and other non-QM products. Backed by top VCs and featured in HousingWire, we’re transforming how borrowers access their home equity.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants ownership, impact, and visibility. You’ll join a small but elite remote team (Brazil, Portugal, US) and play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling the next generation of our lending platform.


  • What You’ll DoLead development of high-quality, scalable web apps using TypeScript + Next.js
  • Drive architectural decisions and shape technical direction
  • Collaborate closely with product and design to ship meaningful features fast
  • Mentor junior/intermediate engineers and raise the bar on code quality
  • Build integrations with cloud infrastructure, credit, income, and valuation vendors
  • Optimize performance, scalability, and security across the stack


  • What We’re Looking For5+ years building and scaling web applications
  • Expert in TypeScript, Next.js, and React
  • Strong experience with MongoDB, Redis, Docker
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP, or other cloud providers
  • Strong communicator, thrives in a remote and autonomous environment
  • Bonus: Zod, tRPC, Prisma, Jest/Playwright, BullMQ, fintech/lending background


  • Why HitchImpact from Day 1: Your code will be in the hands of thousands of brokers and borrowers immediately
  • High-Growth Startup: Join a company that is powering some of the largest lenders in Non-QM (loans for entrepreneurs) mortgage space
  • Elite Team: Work with sharp, collaborative engineers across Brazil, and the US
  • Remote-Friendly: Flexible work, with focus on ownership not hours


How to Apply

Apply here:


  • Tell us why you want to join Hitch and how your skills align with our stack.

title: Dax engineer
description:
Job Title: DAX Engineer (Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012)

Industry: Transportation & Supply Chain

Location: Remote


About the Role:

Our client is seeking a skilled DAX Engineer to enhance and maintain their on-prem Microsoft Dynamics AX environment. This role bridges technical development and business operations, working closely with stakeholders across transportation and supply chain functions. The ideal candidate is a Microsoft Dynamics AX specialist with strong technical skills and the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions.


Key Responsibilities:


Develop, configure, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012) solutions to support business operations.


Work within an on-prem AX environment, ensuring stability, reliability, and performance.


Design and implement technical solutions using C# and .NET.


Collaborate with functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver effective solutions.


Support system integrations, customizations, upgrades, and performance optimizations.


Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application or system issues efficiently.


Document system designs, processes, and best practices to maintain operational clarity.


Contribute to the continuous improvement of AX systems and workflows.


Required Skills & Experience:


Proven experience with Microsoft Dynamics AX (AX 2012).


Hands-on development experience using C# and .NET.


Background as a DAX / Microsoft Engineer, with strong understanding of enterprise systems.


Comfortable in a techno-functional role, engaging both technical and business stakeholders.


Experience supporting on-premise enterprise systems and ensuring operational stability.


Preferred Experience:


Previous exposure to transportation, logistics, or supply chain industries.


Experience with large-scale, enterprise ERP environments.


Understanding of operational workflows in supply chain or freight operations.

title: Desenvolvedor Back End SR
description:
Desenvolvedor Back End - atuação internacional


Descrição:

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade imediata para Desenvolvedores experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Atuação:

Como desenvolvedor de software você será responsável por projetar, codificar, testar e executar aplicativos de software construídos com arquitetura de microsserviços, que se comunicam por meio de APIs e são hospedados na AWS. Esses aplicativos possibilitam experiências digitais inovadoras e baseadas em dados que melhoram a eficácia operacional de um dos maiores players Globais no seguimento. Você trabalhará como parte de uma equipe ágil, com consultores de várias localidades do globo, empregando as melhores práticas em desenvolvimento, segurança e design.


Perfil técnico:

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência como engenheiro de software
  • B.Sc. em ciência da computação, engenharia elétrica ou equivalente
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência em Python
  • Experiência com Golang é uma vantagem
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de frameworks de serviços distribuídos
  • Experiência prática com bancos de dados distribuídos, como RDS/Aurora/PostgreSQL, Redshift, DynamoDB, Redis, MongoDB, etc.
  • Experiência prática no uso de tecnologias de correio de mensagens, como SNS/SQS, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, etc.
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência com a AWS
  • Experiência com CDK é uma vantagem
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Microsserviços, Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência na construção de pipelines CI/CD usando Terraform (preferencial) ou Azure DevOps


Mandatório:

  • Bacharelado em Ciências da Computação ou similar;
  • Inglês fluente

title: Desenvolvedor Front Angular Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57017



Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Desenvolvedor Front-End com experiência em Angular 2+, CSS, HTML, javascript, AWS
  • Desejável conhecimento em Java;
  • CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios
  • 100% remoto.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Account Executive
description:
Near is a startup focused on bridging the gap between remote Latin American talent and companies hiring in the US and abroad. Our team spans 20+ members across four different countries. We've landed numerous great customers and have helped hundreds of people from LatAm improve their lives and wallets with jobs at US companies.


We're looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive who is autonomous, creative, and enterprising to join our team. This is a financially rewarding opportunity with a highly competitive compensation structure – uncapped commission. If you can source and qualify leads effectively, you'll make a lot of money.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve sales targets
  • Expand revenue originated from existing accounts
  • Create new opportunities through outbound prospecting.
  • Close inbound leads
  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships
  • Leverage our existing network to get referrals
  • Understand industry-specific landscapes and trends.
  • Become an expert in the staffing industry.


Qualifications:

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Native-like English level
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve and effectively manage time.
  • A proactive mindset: always pursuing your next goal.
  • Motivated by commission and career growth.
  • Track record of exceeding quota as SDR.


Traits that Would Make You a Strong Fit:

  • Proactive.
  • Optimistic and positive.
  • Intense, driving, and impatient (with regard to results and getting work done).
  • Pay attention to detail when necessary.
  • High EQ – can read the room and connect with people
  • Responds empathetic to others.
  • Follow-through skills.
  • Accountability


Benefits :

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Uncapped commission – the more you close, the higher your commission will be.
  • Results-focused role and team. No BS. No unnecessary processes and bureaucracy.
  • Opportunity to grow and work on larger and more complex deals.
  • A team with a great culture.
  • Join a team of high-performers.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.
